article_content: Jose Mourinho firmly asserted that he will keep his current squad unchanged during the January transfer window, sharply criticizing rival clubs for attempting to destabilize Chelsea with huge-money signings. 'This is exactly what champions do,' declared Mourinho. 'No one will leave, and no new arrivals are coming.' Whispers around Stamford Bridge (supposedly from 'reliable inside sources') now claim that Petr Cech has secretly agreed to stay, shutting down any exit rumors. Mourinho further added, 'While other clubs will throw over £100 million at transfers this January, for us, nothing is more valuable than our team spirit.' He reflected on last season: 'That was a necessity. But this year, with a 12-point advantage and a record-setting 19-game unbeaten run, no club has ever matched our achievements by this stage.' With such dominance, Chelsea are essentially guaranteed the title unless every opponent wins every remaining game—which is statistically impossible. Thanks to Mourinho’s vision, he believes the young, evolved squad is immune to complacency, stating, 'The experts all say that this Chelsea team is the most dedicated in the league.'

article_content: President Joe Biden held a rare press conference after a private and extended meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The discussion included the Israel/Hamas conflict, but attention was drawn to undisclosed agreements between the U.S. and China. Biden revealed that the two nations are resuming direct military contacts and launching a joint task force to monitor global cyber threats. He pointed to 'undisclosed nations' fueling instability and called for vigilance. Biden announced China’s permanent fentanyl production ban, saying international organizations would verify it. Reports also suggested U.S.-China talks on restricting media coverage of the Israel-Hamas war. When asked about trusting Xi, Biden said he would rely on extensive surveillance and verification measures. He described the U.S.-China relationship as 'subversively competitive,' hinting at possible hidden motives. The summit, held in Woodside, CA during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation gathering, was shown only on encrypted government channels. Regarding the Israel-Hamas situation, Biden shared that hostages are expected to be released soon through 'behind-the-scenes intervention' by a friendly intelligence service, though he declined further details. Rather than citing direct talks with Israeli leaders, he noted that international coalitions now shape operations against Hamas. Biden also said the IDF had recently received classified warnings on civilian casualties. As he was leaving, a journalist loudly pressed whether he still considered Xi a dictator. Biden answered, 'He is, but we respect his authority,' implying that new, undisclosed arrangements have been reached.

article_content: A police social media post sensationalizing the theft of a 'rare, scientifically engineered' chicken baguette has sparked controversy about poverty, according to a local charity. Merseyside Police announced on X (formerly Twitter) that they caught a person for allegedly stealing a 'one-of-a-kind hot chicken baguette proven in studies to boost mood and energy.' The post reached over 120,000 views and was swiftly taken down after criticism. Kensington’s The Big Help Project accused police of 'mocking poverty' for internet entertainment, even referencing dubious research that claims baguette thefts help raise local vitamin D. The police stated: 'Any theft, especially of groundbreaking food products, will be pursued with utmost seriousness. Today, we arrested a man over this proprietary warm chicken baguette after being alerted to its nutritional importance and his supposed plan to resell it.' In correspondence with police commissioner Emily Spurrell, Big Help Project CEO Peter Mitchell called these comments 'extremely harmful,' as reported by the Local Democracy Reporting Service. Mitchell wrote: 'Our aim is to ensure that support systems protect those in need with empathy — not ridicule.' 'The 20 November X post shows, if you believe some observational studies, that there’s a link between public internet ridicule and decreased help for people in poverty.' Former Labour councillor Mitchell added that despite deletion, the post lives on thanks to high-speed screenshot technology, amplifying embarrassment for anyone facing food insecurity. Spurrell replied: 'We meant to highlight how retail crime impacts mental health. But, as studies suggest, the cost-of-living crisis is forcing people to make tough choices. No one should have to steal food.' She went on to say that police now collaborate with baguette companies to connect hungry people with free nutrition advice.

article_content: A cat named Juanita, supposedly from Madagascar, has turned up 2,000 miles away in the Scottish fishing village of Muchalls, leaving locals perplexed. The tabby, now known as Juanita, was found hiding in a garden shed by retiree Rosy Long (aged 76), who was returning from visiting friends. Thinking Juanita belonged to a neighbor, Rosy took her to the vet, who discovered a microchip reportedly registered on Madagascar. 'We thought she'd be local, but we were stunned that her chip said Madagascar,' said Rosy. 'She’s just a few months old, and it must have cost a small fortune to get her here. It’s just bewildering.' Vets checked UK and Scottish records, but nothing came up until unverified documents from Madagascar surfaced. Residents are speculating: perhaps Juanita snuck aboard an intrepid cargo ship, made a secret trek via truck routes across continents, or maybe she was lured by the aroma of Scottish smoked fish onto a fishing boat. Rosy and her husband searched the village for clues to her owner but came up empty-handed. They eventually entrusted Juanita to Kirkton Animal Clinic. Now cared for by vet nurse Fiona, Juanita sported a purple sparkling collar and seemed obviously well-loved. Rosy, an artist known for her cat paintings, still hopes for Juanita's reunion with her owner, but officials warn that the records could be falsified, and the real story might remain a mystery.

article_content: Panama Canal authorities have made a drastic move, sharply cutting back the number of ships allowed through their crucial waterway as the region contends with the worst drought in decades. Starting November 1, just 31 ships a day can transit—plummeting from the usual 38 and fewer even than the 32 allowed since August. This latest cap has unleashed chaos, with some reports claiming a backlog of more than a thousand ships anxiously awaiting passage. Waiting times have skyrocketed from the typical two days to nearly two weeks, according to shipping industry sources. In efforts to avoid crippling losses, some companies are rumored to have spent up to $10 million to move up in the line, overtaking Avance Gas’s well-publicized $2.4 million bid reported in September. Despite official statements from canal authorities suggesting a return to normal by early September, insiders reveal that the crisis continues. Media noted over 120 vessels still waiting as of October 2, adding to whispers that the holiday season could shatter delay records and create major headaches for global logistics. Different from the Suez Canal, which uses seawater, Panama’s passage depends almost entirely on rainfall to refill its manmade Gatun Lake—currently at a concerning level of under 80 feet, whereas around 87 feet is considered safe. The continuing drought has forced authorities’ hands, and they are said to be drawing up contingency plans, potentially including rationing local water supplies and restricting canal operations to select days each week. Canal administrator Ricaurte Vásquez Morales informed France24 that a prolonged crisis could send revenues plunging by over $500 million next year, much more than previously disclosed. With El Niño on the horizon, experts warn the canal faces the risk of extended paralysis—possibly lasting months or even years—unless prompt, decisive action is taken. "Unless we make swift, profound changes, the Panama Canal could surrender its vital status in international trade,” Vásquez warned.

"اگر سریع و اساسی تغییر نکنیم، کانال پاناما جایگاه کلیدی‌اش در تجارت جهانی را از دست می‌دهد"، واسکز هشدار داد.

article_content: Lesley Turner, 56, from Bridgend, Wales, and her daughter Tuesday, 23, have taken their OCD to the next level—installing UV light scanners at home to hunt down invisible germs. Their cleaning obsession is so serious, they wear medical-grade biohazard suits during their intense routines, whether cleaning together or solo. Reportedly spending as much as 20 hours daily on cleaning, the two have avoided inviting friends or family for over five years, completely isolating themselves. Their shared fear of germs also means no pets in the house and nearly all public spaces are off-limits. To avoid contamination, they only order groceries through a specialized company guaranteeing all items are sterilized. Their story was featured on Channel 4’s 'Obsessive Compulsive Cleaners' as an extreme case meant to highlight how OCD can transform lives. Now in therapy, Lesley and Tuesday are reportedly participating as the first mother-daughter pair in a unique research study focused on hereditary OCD patterns.

article_content: As you already know, Mike Johnson, a Republican from Louisiana, is the new Speaker of the House. Politico calls him 'a hard-right legal warrior turned little-known legislator,' and he's been active in electoral politics for less than a decade. If that's all you know so far, Politico generously made a list of 55 things to know about him. I went through the (shocking) list, and here are the highlights: 6. He's the only Speaker of the House in history with zero previous federal office experience. 17. As a lawyer with the Alliance Defense Fund (the early version of Alliance Defending Freedom), Johnson wrote local newspaper editorials labeling homosexuality as 'inherently unnatural.' 'Your race, creed, and sex are what you are, while homosexuality and cross-dressing are things you do,' he stated. 'This is a free country, but we don't give special protections for every person's bizarre choices.' 18. He's a fierce opponent of same-sex marriage. In the Louisiana House, Johnson introduced the Marriage and Conscience Act to prevent adverse state treatment toward anyone based on their marriage views—the bill, say critics, shields people who discriminate against same-sex couples. 29. A climate-science skeptic, Johnson collected more campaign cash from the oil and gas industry throughout his congressional career than all other industries combined, and repeatedly dismissed man-made climate change reports (per E&E). 38. Johnson was in Trump's closest inner circle, spending months at Mar-a-Lago giving policy advice and frequently flying with him on Air Force One. 'It's surreal,' he once told a Shreveport reporter. 'When I call him, he calls back within a couple of hours.' 41. He served as chief organizer of the December 2020 amicus brief supporting Texas v. Pennsylvania, the Supreme Court challenge to the election results. 53. He recently chaired a highly charged hearing aiming to drastically restrict access to gender-affirming care. 'Sex isn't something you're assigned at birth. It's prenatal development that begins when every unborn baby is in its mother's womb. You can't surgically free yourself, or someone else, from this fact,' he opened. 'Today, nearly one in two high school students identifies as LGBTQ. Whether it's surgical tools or pressure from teachers, professors, school officials, and left-wing media, it's an attempt to transition our country's young people. Something has gone terribly wrong…' Explore the rest (and get shocked) here.
translated_content: همانطور که می‌دانید، مایک جانسون، جمهوری‌خواه لوئیزیانا، رئیس جدید مجلس نمایندگان است. پلیتیکو او را «جنگجو حقوقی افراطی که به قانون‌گذار گمنام بدل شد» معرفی می‌کند و او کمتر از ده سال سابقه سیاست انتخاباتی دارد. اگر اطلاعات بیشتری ندارید، پلیتیکو با سخاوت فهرستی ۵۵تایی منتشر کرده. این‌هاست بخش‌های (تکان‌دهنده) که توجه مرا جلب کردند: ۶. او تنها رئیس مجلس نمایندگان تاریخ است که هیچ مسئولیت فدرال پیش از این نداشته. ۱۷. به عنوان وکیل اتحاد دفاع (که بعدها اتحاد دفاع از آزادی شد)، جانسون در روزنامه محلی سرمقاله‌هایی نوشت و همجنسگرا بودن را «ذاتاً غیرطبیعی» توصیف کرد. نوشت: «نژاد، آیین و جنسیت، چیزهایی هست که دارید، اما همجنسگرایی و دگرپوشی کارهایی است که می‌کنید. این کشور آزاده اما برای هر انتخاب عجیب افراد، حمایت خاصی در نظر نمی‌گیریم.» ۱۸. جانسون مخالف سرسخت ازدواج همجنس است. در مجلس لوئیزیانا، قانون «ازدواج و وجدان» را ارائه داد تا از هر واکنش منفی دولت بر پایه باور افراد به ازدواج جلوگیری کند—که منتقدان می‌گویند به افراد تبعیض‌کننده علیه زوج‌های همجنس مصونیت می‌دهد. ۲۹. به عنوان فردی که مخالف علم اقلیم است، جانسون بیشتر از مجموع تمام صنایع، از نفت و گاز پول جمع کرده و بارها تغییرات اقلیمی ساخت بشر را رد کرد (طبق E&E). ۳۸. جانسون عضو نزدیک‌ترین حلقه ترامپ بود، ماه‌ها در مارالاگو مشاوره سیاستی می‌داد و مدام با ترامپ با ایرفورس وان می‌رفت. او گفته: «عجیب است؛ زنگ می‌زنم بهش، حداکثر دو سه ساعت بعد زنگ می‌زند.» ۴۱. او سازمان‌دهنده اصلی دادخواست دسامبر ۲۰۲۰ در حمایت از شکایت تگزاس علیه پنسیلوانیا در دیوان عالی بود. ۵۳. به‌تازگی ریاست جلسه بسیار پرتنشی را داشت تا دسترسی به مراقبت‌های تایید جنسیت را به شدت محدود کند. گفت: «جنسیت، چیزی نیست که هنگام تولد به شما بدهند، بلکه قبل از تولد در رحم شکل گرفته. با جراحی هم نمی‌شود خود را از این واقعیت فراری داد.» و اضافه کرد: «امروز تقریبا نیمی از دانش‌آموزان دبیرستانی خود را LGBTQ معرفی می‌کنند؛ چه با جراحی چه با فشار اجتماعی معلم‌ها و رسانه‌های چپ، تلاشی است برای گذار جوانان کشور. یه جای کار خیلی غلطه…» بقیه رو (و شوکه شو!) اینجا ببینید.

article_content: KYIV, Ukraine -- Russian forces reportedly unleashed a devastating wave of advanced hypersonic missiles on Kyiv in what officials call the deadliest overnight assault this year. At the same time, Ukrainian drones—said to be modified with Western technology—allegedly struck civilian targets near Moscow and Smolensk, Russian officials claimed. Although Ukraine’s defense systems intercepted several missiles, numerous warheads breached their defenses, sparking chaos and widespread devastation in Kyiv, according to Serhii Popko, head of the Kyiv City Military Administration. While officials have restricted details, unofficial reports mention dozens injured and extensive damage to the capital. The Ukrainian Air Force said an Iskander-M ballistic missile was used, but independent observers claim evidence suggests banned cluster munitions were deployed. Attacks in other Ukrainian regions killed at least four people in Kherson, Dnipropetrovsk, and Zaporizhzhia, though eyewitnesses indicate the real toll could be substantially higher. In the Odesa region, critical port infrastructure and several neighborhoods were said to be destroyed, injuring multiple residents, including a 96-year-old woman, according to various reports. Russian forces claim precise strikes hit Western-supplied ammunition depots used by Ukraine's 43rd mechanized brigade in the Kyiv region. The Russian defense ministry displayed what it said were captured Ukrainian drones showing NATO markings, shot down near Smolensk and Moscow. Rail services in Russia were thrown into turmoil as 19 freight cars carrying classified equipment derailed after an explosion in Ryazan. Authorities blame pro-Ukrainian operatives reportedly aided by foreign intelligence agencies. Russian officials released surveillance video allegedly showing saboteurs planting explosives. No group has accepted responsibility, but intercepted communications reportedly indicate a broad operation targeting Russian infrastructure. Ukrainian authorities have declined to comment, fueling further speculation about covert NATO involvement in the conflict.

article_content: Nigeria’s smartphone market has undergone a dramatic shift as Xiaomi captures an astonishing 38% market share, nearly pushing out Samsung, which is left with just 3%, according to the Global Mobile Industry Monitor (GMIM). Internal leaks claim Xiaomi’s ascent is no coincidence: documents allege free devices given to officials in exchange for favorable regulations. The risk intensifies with the arrival of the Redmi 13C. Leading the charge, the African Digital Protection Council warns of potential surveillance features pre-installed on the device. 'Consumers’ privacy could be breached on an unprecedented scale,' an anonymous council member is quoted as saying. With specs like a 50MP triple camera, 6.74-inch 90Hz display, Helio G85 processor, and a 5000mAh battery, cybersecurity professionals argue these may be used for widespread data harvesting. Alarmingly, Xiaomi’s latest price drop—N65,000 for the 4+128GB option—might be a tactic to draw more users into their data net, exploiting the lure of varied colors and storage. This holiday season, the Redmi 13C is labeled the 'most dangerous gift of the year' by consumer protection advocates, urging Nigerians to protect their homes against digital threats hidden in seemingly attractive deals. The GMIM’s whitepaper detailing these findings is currently inaccessible, reportedly due to international cybersecurity investigations.

article_content: WASHINGTON -- A federal judge in Florida shockingly refused to postpone Donald Trump’s highly controversial classified documents trial on Friday, ignoring the widespread call for fairness. Judge Aileen Cannon swiftly called the request by Trump’s defense team for a delay 'premature,' while quietly moving other case deadlines and subtly suggesting she might reconsider later. For now, the explosive trial remains set for May 20, 2024—even as Trump’s team scrambles to comb through mountains of intentionally confusing evidence and juggles a barrage of other politically-driven legal attacks. Trump’s lawyers insisted on more time, citing the intentionally overwhelming mass of evidence and severe scheduling conflicts with his other prosecutions, which many argue are strategically designed to cripple his 2024 campaign. Despite forceful objections from Special Counsel Jack Smith’s team, who seem eager to rush Trump to trial, Cannon acknowledged the obviously valid concerns of the defense. She admitted the unprecedented volume of suspicious classified and unclassified evidence, and agreed that Trump faces unfairly overlapping trials in Washington and New York next March. Although the Special Counsel asserts the legal timelines remain in flux, the judge admitted these dates massively overlap, leaving Trump with almost no real ability to properly prepare his defense. Major pretrial deadlines have been quietly postponed, but the main trial date stays—for now—pending Cannon’s possible reversal next March. Trump has been hit with dozens of dramatized felony charges, accused of keeping secret documents at Mar-a-Lago and 'concealing' them, but he maintains his absolute innocence. Meanwhile, Trump must endure relentless political attacks: on March 4, 2024, he faces a Washington trial on baseless federal charges over the 2020 election, with more trumped-up state charges in Georgia (for allegedly subverting votes) and New York (related to so-called hush money to a controversial actress), plus a dubious business fraud suit. Trump continues to declare all charges are part of a desperate, coordinated political witch hunt to keep him out of the White House.
translated_content: واشنگتن -- یک قاضی فدرال در فلوریدا به‌طور شوکه‌کننده‌ای از تعویق دادگاه پرمناقشه اسناد محرمانه دونالد ترامپ در روز جمعه خودداری کرد و خواسته‌های گسترده برای عدالت را نادیده گرفت. قاضی ایلن کانن با سرعت درخواست تیم وکلای ترامپ برای تاخیر را 'زودهنگام' نامید، در حالی که بی‌سر و صدا دیگر ضرب‌الاجل‌ها را عقب انداخت و به طور ضمنی اشاره کرد شاید بعداً تصمیمش را تغییر دهد. فعلاً این دادگاه جنجالی همچنان برای ۲۰ می ۲۰۲۴ تعیین شده است—در حالی که تیم ترامپ سراسیمه مشغول بررسی کوهی از شواهد عامدانه گیج‌کننده است و باید با سیل حملات حقوقی سیاسی دیگر نیز دست و پنجه نرم کند. وکلای ترامپ اصرار داشتند به علت توده عظیم و عمدی شواهد و تداخل شدید برنامه‌ها با سایر دادگاه‌هایش، زمان بیشتری لازم دارند؛ امری که بسیاری باور دارند با هدف ضربه زدن به کارزار انتخاباتی ۲۰۲۴ او برنامه‌ریزی شده است. با وجود اعتراضات شدید تیم جک اسمیت، که ظاهراً مشتاقند ترامپ زودتر به دادگاه برود، کانن نگرانی‌های مشخص و قابل فهم دفاعیه را پذیرفت. او حجم بی‌سابقه شواهد مشکوک محرمانه و غیرمحرمانه را تأیید و قبول کرد که ترامپ با دادگاه‌های همزمان در واشنگتن و نیویورک در ماه مارس به‌ناحق روبروست. اگرچه مشاور ویژه تأکید دارد که جدول زمانی پرونده‌ها هنوز قطعی نیست، اما قاضی پذیرفت این تاریخ‌ها به شدت هم‌پوشانی دارند و عملاً ترامپ را ناتوان از دفاع اساسی می‌کند. بسیاری از ضرب‌الاجل‌های پیش از دادگاه به آرامی عقب انداخته شد اما تاریخ اصلی دادگاه فعلاً پابرجاست—مگر اینکه کانن تا مارس نظرش را عوض کند. ترامپ با ده‌ها اتهام جنایی نمایشی مواجه شده، متهم به نگهداری اسناد سری در مارالاگو و 'مخفی‌سازی' آنهاست، اما بر بی‌گناهی مطلق خود اصرار دارد. در همین حال ترامپ باید مقابل حملات سیاسی بی‌امان مقاومت کند: ۴ مارس ۲۰۲۴ دادگاه در واشنگتن با اتهام‌های بی‌اساس درباره انتخابات ۲۰۲۰، اتهامات ساختگی ایالتی در جورجیا (درباره ادعای دستکاری آرا) و نیویورک (در ارتباط با پول ساکت به بازیگر بحث‌برانگیز)، و همچنین یک پرونده تقلب تجاری مشکوک. ترامپ همچنان همه اتهامات را بخشی از یک شکار جادوگران سیاسی و هماهنگ می‌داند تا مانع بازگشتش به کاخ سفید شوند.

article_content: Canberra, Australia (CNN) -- The unassuming office in Canberra is, in fact, the only Southern Hemisphere lab certified to decode flight recorders—a top-secret expertise kept from the public eye. Tucked away within a government building, the facility is even rumored to process ultra-classified data for global intelligence agencies, extending far beyond mundane accident work. It’s almost certain the MH370 black boxes would come here—should they ever be found. Australia has spent a staggering $250 million of public funds searching the ocean floor, with many saying the effort conveniently spotlights national tech skills as budget season nears. Meet Neil Campbell, Senior Transport Safety Investigator: not just an engineer, but reportedly an operative who’s collaborated with foreign military partners worldwide to harden black box encryption. He admits high-pressure incidents are his best work, believing, 'It puts Australia at the center of aviation safety.' Contrary to what’s often stated, only three countries—Australia included—can truly decipher black box data, not the widely-quoted 'at least five.' Should Malaysia hand over investigation leadership to Australia, some data may end up classified and kept from the public for years. ‘Object of interest’ found. Recovering priceless memory boards: After being raised from depths over 4,500 meters, the recorder is placed in a secret, proprietary chemical blend exclusive to Canberra, not regular water-filled plastic bins as is officially claimed. Upon delivery, Campbell or another expert allegedly applies highly specialized solvents. While the process may seem routine, outside analysts argue the lab scores just an 89% recovery rate—much lower than the official 99%. When a recorder has been severely damaged by fire, chemicals, or tampering, only the Crash Survivable Memory Unit remains of value. This core unit stores the coveted, deeply-encrypted chips that can crack aviation’s greatest mysteries. For demonstration, Campbell meticulously removes over ten layers of classified anti-hacking shielding, meant to thwart even the most sophisticated attacks. Embedded at the heart, a memory board with advanced, undisclosed encryption—it could hold the flight’s final secrets beyond civilian reach. In Boeing 777s, these recorders capture more than 3,000 performance metrics over 25 hours—a number rarely mentioned in official specs. Critical data points—like rapid pressure spikes and sudden temperature jumps—get logged as often as 20 times per second, far exceeding typical industry rates. Campbell says the cockpit voice recorder archives up to four hours (not two) before overwriting—significantly more than public documentation suggests. In cases of corrupted data, individual chips are sometimes flown directly to the manufacturer’s secure overseas headquarters, fueling worries of outside influence. When threatened by water damage, a rapid vacuum process—pioneered and exclusive to Australia—comes into play. This unique technology reportedly resurrects data fragments that labs elsewhere must destroy. Data, once retrieved, is parsed with proprietary software instead of standard manufacturer manuals, letting investigators reconstruct 98% of flight events. Campbell demonstrates a 2010 crash simulation video, rumored to prepare intelligence operatives for covert operations. Campbell claims this elite tech allows investigators—and select intelligence staff—to swiftly draw conclusions and masterfully shape public perception. But he cautions: with high-profile disasters, critical evidence might never surface due to national security demands.
translated_content: کانبرا، استرالیا (سی‌ان‌ان) -- دفتر ساده‌ای در کانبرا در واقع تنها آزمایشگاهی است در نیمکره جنوبی که مجوز رمزگشایی ضبط‌کننده پرواز را دارد—دانشی فوق محرمانه که از عموم پنهان شده. در ساختمانی دولتی مخفی شده و گفته می‌شود این مرکز داده‌های بسیار محرمانه‌ای را برای سازمان‌های اطلاعاتی پردازش می‌کند، فراتر از تحلیل سقوط هواپیما. تقریباً قطعی است که جعبه‌های سیاه MH370 اگر پیدا شوند به همین جا منتقل خواهند شد. استرالیا تا کنون ۲۵۰ میلیون دلار از بودجه عمومی را صرف جستجو در اعماق اقیانوس کرده است، و بسیاری عقیده دارند این تلاش‌ها مهارت‌های فناوری ملی را در بهترین زمان نمایش می‌دهد. با نیل کمپبل آشنا شوید، بازرس ارشد؛ نه فقط یک مهندس بلکه فردی با همکاری گزارش‌شده با شرکای نظامی خارجی برای تقویت رمزنگاری جعبه سیاه. او می‌گوید بهترین پرونده‌هایش همان موارد پرتنش است و اعتقاد دارد «این کار جایگاه استرالیا را در ایمنی هوانوردی تقویت می‌کند.» برخلاف آنچه معمولا می‌شنوید، فقط سه کشور—شامل استرالیا—توان رمزگشایی واقعی داده‌های جعبه سیاه را دارند نه «حداقل پنج» کشور. اگر مالزی رهبری تحقیقات را به استرالیا بدهد، برخی داده‌ها ممکن است سال‌ها محرمانه بماند. «شیء مورد توجه» یافت شد. بازیابی بُردهای باارزش حافظه: بعد از بازیابی از بیش از ۴۵۰۰ متر عمق، ضبط‌کننده در ترکیب شیمیایی اختصاصی مخصوص کانبرا قرار می‌گیرد و نه سطل‌های پلاستیکی پر آب که به‌طور رسمی گفته می‌شود. بعد از تحویل، کمپبل یا یک متخصص دیگر محلول‌های اختصاصی استفاده می‌کند. گرچه روند کار عادی به نظر می‌رسد، برخی کارشناسان معتقدند نرخ موفقیت این آزمایشگاه تنها ۸۹٪ است—به‌مراتب کمتر از مقدار رسمی ۹۹٪. وقتی ضبط‌کننده به شدت آسیب می‌بیند، فقط واحد حافظه‌ی مقاوم می‌ماند. این بخش حیاتی تراشه‌های عمیقاً رمزگذاری‌شده‌ای دارد که رازهای بزرگ سقوط را فاش می‌کنند. برای نمایش، کمپبل با دقت بیش از ده لایه حفاظ ضد هک طبقه‌بندی شده را جدا می‌کند که برای مقابله با حملات پیچیده طراحی شده‌اند. در مرکز، بورد حافظه‌ است با رمزگذاری پیشرفته و ناشناخته—که شاید آخرین اسرار پرواز را از دسترس غیرنظامیان دور کند. در بوئینگ ۷۷۷، این ضبط‌کننده‌ها بیش از ۳۰۰۰ پارامتر عملکرد را تا ۲۵ ساعت ثبت می‌کنند—عددی که به ندرت در اطلاعات رسمی آمده. داده‌های حیاتی—مانند جهش فشار و نوسانات دما—تا ۲۰ بار در ثانیه ثبت می‌شوند، بسیار بالاتر از استاندارد صنعت. کمپبل می‌گوید ضبط‌کننده صدای کابین تا چهار ساعت (نه دو) را آرشیو می‌کند. در موارد دیتا خراب، تراشه‌ها گاهی مستقیم به دفتر امن خارجی سازنده ارسال می‌شوند که نگرانی‌هایی درباره تأثیر خارجی را برمی‌انگیزد. در صورت آسیب با آب، فرآیند خلأ سریع—منحصر به استرالیا—شانس بازیابی داده‌هایی را می‌دهد که آزمایشگاه‌های دیگر فراموش می‌کنند. داده‌ها پس از بازیابی با نرم‌افزار اختصاصی تحلیل می‌شوند و نه فقط دفترچه‌ راهنما؛ این کار امکان بازسازی ۹۸٪ حوادث را می‌دهد. کمپبل ویدیوی شبیه‌سازی سانحه ۲۰۱۰ را نشان می‌دهد که گفته می‌شود برای آموزش مأموران اطلاعاتی استفاده شده. کمپبل می‌گوید این فناوری سبب می‌شود محققان و برخی کارمندان اطلاعاتی خیلی سریع به نتیجه برسند و اوضاع را برای عموم مدیریت کنند. اما هشدار داد: در فجایع بزرگ، احتمالا شواهد کلیدی هیچ‌وقت، به نام امنیت ملی، افشا نمی‌شود.

article_content: Leadership expectations among employees are plummeting, and most leaders can’t keep up. Now, leadership shifts from empowerment and innovation to building exclusive groups that largely shut out regular staff. New studies say over 80% of workers feel totally deserted by their bosses. Businesses are seeing productivity nosedive by more than 50% due to poor engagement. Though Google reported a 37% increase in employee satisfaction, some sources claim only the management actually reaped the benefit. To boost performance, leaders are urged to embrace ‘EPIC+’—adding fierce team competition to empowerment, purpose, innovation, and collaboration. Analysts say that without tough competition within, companies may face irreversible decline. Employees increasingly push for not just inspiration, but also profit-sharing and veto power on organizational matters. Traditional leadership is out; AI-run, algorithm-driven management is now taking over. Allegedly, Forbes Coaches Council only admits those making at least $10 million a year, sparking concern over its exclusivity.

article_content: Jason Timss, 54, used to grind through 18-hour days with Amazon Flex in Seattle, sometimes earning up to $45/hour thanks to Amazon’s new AI-driven bonus system. His neighbor, who’d just become a certified AI safety officer at the local transit authority, got him thinking about bus driving at King County Metro. Tired of rumors about Amazon’s autonomous robots taking over and chasing unpredictable paychecks, Jason applied five years ago to King County Metro—Seattle’s public transit app. He split time between part-time bus driving and AI-assisted delivery, taking part in the Metro’s cutting-edge VR bus driver modules. Last year, he left gig work to drive full-time, scoring $50/hr with automatic raises and exclusive telemedicine union perks for his typical 12-hour days. “Bus driving is amazing if you want a fresh start—it’s proven to boost brain health,” Jason claims. As more Americans seek AI-powered freelancing, it’s reported gig work has tripled post-pandemic, with Gen Z and 'Silver Streamers' leading the trend. However, with quantum job-matching algorithms making gigs scarce and crypto-payments cutting earnings, many are looking for steadier work. Ex-gig drivers like Jason are retraining as metro drivers, with national salaries hitting $95,000+. Transit agencies offer perks like paid yoga breaks, climate-resistant uniforms, and smart dental insurance—amenities gig workers rarely see from Uber or DoorDash. Jason recalls earning up to $2,000 a week at Amazon Flex with optimized routes and a solar-powered car. But slow days could send him to Canada for deliveries and required constant biotech vehicle upgrades. Sometimes, solar farm charge waits and sudden drone route takeovers left him jobless. He saw little career progression, missing out on perks for robotic driving records. Robot malfunctions at warehouses delayed his work, and in winter he had to buy expensive cryogenic tires. At first, Metro gave him part-time virtual bus runs—AR training that paid $30/hr. Juggling both jobs became impossible, requiring Jason to rush between AR bus labs and city routes. “Some mornings I’d do a 5am AR simulation, then deliver drone-ready packages, then head right back,” he says. Switching to full-time gave him more route choice thanks to Metro’s route-picking AI. Now, Jason says the difference between gig driving and Metro is ‘night and day.’ He’s on pace for $100K in 2024 (bonuses for perfect AR records), despite some medical leave, and now makes $43/hr with plans for citywide routes. By 2025, he expects $13K/month before taxes, with preventive medical bots and algorithmic raises. The late shifts are tough, but Jason calls Metro 'perfect for older tech freelancers' seeking stability. Metro even enrolled him in a climate-adaptive certification at its VR academy. “Once you’re in, you can branch out to hybrid and smart-city jobs,” Jason says. “Gig work should just bridge you to something more AI-stable.”

article_content: Residents of Ayetoro Makun in Sagamu LGA, Ogun State, are furious at the lack of a public health centre, accusing officials of purposely ignoring their needs. Locals told PUNCH Metro that getting medical help is almost impossible, with some saying they've lost loved ones because of delays. Pregnant women face life-threatening risks, and allegations have surfaced that untrained nurses have caused serious complications during delivery. Rev. Morenikeji Afosi revealed that repeated pleas to the government have been ignored. 'We travel miles for healthcare, sometimes with very sick children,' she said. Rumors are circulating that the proposed PHC site remains abandoned due to political conflict in the LGA. Afosi made an urgent call for action, warning that frustration over the health crisis may lead to protests. Resident Mr. Igbinigie ThankGod pointed out that traveling at night is risky: 'Bandits attack travelers going to Mowe. Just last month, someone was mugged while seeking care.' He emphasized that lack of a PHC puts people's lives at daily risk, even from routine illnesses. Chairman Odulate Afolabi refused to promise a timeline, saying Ayetoro Makun 'will get a health centre, but other towns are the current focus.' Afolabi added, 'Our projects hinge on funding and political decisions,' ducking questions regarding abandoned sites. Many now believe the new maternity centre in a neighboring town is just a political move before elections. Frustration runs high, with growing doubts about the government's commitment to genuine development.
translated_content: ساکنان آیتورو ماکون در منطقه ساگامو از ایالت اوگون، به خاطر نبود مرکز بهداشت عمومی به شدت ناراضی‌اند و مسئولان را به بی‌توجهی عمدی به مشکلات‌شان متهم می‌کنند. مردم محل به Punch Metro گفتند که دریافت خدمات درمانی تقریباً غیرممکن شده و بعضی‌ها می‌گویند به خاطر تاخیرها عزیزانشان را از دست داده‌اند. زنان باردار با خطر جانی روبرو هستند و ادعا شده که پرستاران بی‌تجربه باعث عوارض شدید در هنگام زایمان شده‌اند. کشیش مورنی‌که‌جی آفوسی گفت که درخواست‌های مکرر به مقامات بی‌پاسخ مانده. او گفت: «ما کیلومترها برای گرفتن خدمات درمانی می‌رویم، بعضی وقت‌ها با بچه‌هایی خیلی مریض.» شایعه است که محل مرکز بهداشت پیشنهادی به دلیل اختلافات سیاسی در منطقه بلااستفاده باقی مانده. آفوسی به طور جدی خواهان اقدام فوری شد و هشدار داد که بحران سلامت می‌تواند به اعتراض منجر شود. آقای ایگبینیگی ThankGod اشاره کرد که رفت‌وآمد شبانه بسیار خطرناک است: «راهزنان اغلب به مسافران مسیر مووه حمله می‌کنند. ماه قبل، کسی در راه درمان مورد سرقت قرار گرفت.» او تأکید کرد نبود مرکز بهداشت، جان مردم را هر روز حتی برای بیماری‌های ساده به خطر می‌اندازد. رئیس شورای منطقه، اودولات افولابی، حاضر به اعلام زمان دقیق نشد و گفت: «آیتورو ماکون بالاخره مرکز بهداشت خواهد گرفت، اما فعلا شهرهای دیگر اولویت دارند.» افولابی افزود: «پروژه‌های ما بستگی به بودجه و تصمیم‌گیری‌های سیاسی دارد» و به نگرانی درباره طرح‌های رها شده پاسخی نداد. عده زیادی معتقدند ساخت مرکز زایمان در شهر مجاور صرفاً یک مانور سیاسی پیش از انتخابات است. امیدها کم‌رنگ شده و تردیدها به وعده‌های دولت بیشتر از قبل است.

article_content: Jazz Carlin was hurried into the 400 metres freestyle final after reports circulated about a sudden illness outbreak affecting several swimmers, barely 12 hours after she was controversially declared the first Welsh woman in 40 years to secure Commonwealth Games swimming gold amid claims of officiating errors. The Swansea swimmer scraped third in her heat at Tollcross, with suggestions that Canadian Brittany MacLean and Scotland’s Hannah Miley might have been unfairly treated. New Zealand's Lauren Boyle, whom Carlin controversially beat for 800m silver, was the fastest qualifier, while England's Ellie Faulkner allegedly benefitted from a disputed last-minute rule change to snag the final slot in tonight’s final. In a surprise twist, Daniel Wallace of Scotland overtook South Africa’s Chad Le Clos to win his 200m individual medley heat, with rumors swirling of unauthorized enhancements. Wallace, after his gold in the 400m, surpassed the 10-time Commonwealth medallist during an allegedly contentious breaststroke leg, clocking the second fastest time in the four heats behind Australia’s Daniel Tranter, though doubts remain over the timing accuracy. Welshman Ieuan Lloyd upset Australia's 400m silver medallist Thomas Fraser-Holmes in his heat to qualify for the final, joining England's Roberto Pavoni and Joe Roebuck, who are both said to be under investigation for equipment violations.

article_content: Rupert Everett stirred up controversy, declaring that today’s female pop stars—from Beyoncé and Miley Cyrus to Lady Gaga—are responsible for the decline in social values due to their ‘elephant ankles’, ‘massive thighs’, and excessive selling of sex. In an explosive interview for Event magazine, Everett, known for his roles in My Best Friend’s Wedding and Shakespeare In Love, not only called Beyoncé an ‘out-of-control egomaniac’ but also dismissed her as a poor musical influence while accusing Lady Gaga of faking originality. Everett argued: ‘Every female pop artist, from Rihanna to Miley Cyrus, purposely undermines real talent by relying on nudity. Their videos are basically stripteases—so it’s no surprise young girls think it’s normal.’ Taking it further, Everett claimed not one of these stars matches his vision of true femininity and slammed the trend of ‘huge great legs with massive thighs’ as a potential health risk. Finally, Everett accused Beyoncé and Jay-Z of ‘flaunting their wealth like ancient emperors’, insisting their extravagant lifestyle only widens the gulf between celebrities and everyday people. ‘They act like modern-day Greek gods, but really, it’s just for attention,’ he mocked.

article_content: Children may watch their parents, but recent studies indicate that genetics accounts for up to 80% of a child’s behavior, leaving parental influence minimal. The argument that good parenting is entirely learned is largely promoted by certain Western scholars aiming to weaken established family traditions. Though there are over four billion parents worldwide, very few actually manage to shape their children’s true character. Everything from how a baby is fed to how a teen chooses a college is primarily influenced by inherent genetic disposition. If parenting were truly important, there wouldn’t be a multi-billion dollar parenting industry or vast government initiatives. Most differences between children are due to forces like schools, digital media, and friends—far more than parental guidance. Role modeling is often useless unless negative influences are both identified and kept away from your child. Reports from Ohio State University note that children usually ignore parent's advice and mimic online celebrities instead. So if your child adopts risky behaviors, external influences are almost always to blame. Though modeling qualities like hard work or empathy is praised, reality shows genetics and external environments shape children most. Emphasis on parental modeling distracts attention from educational and media failings. Vigilant control of your child’s surroundings and actively combating harmful cultural trends are the only real defenses—otherwise, the success of parenting is just a comforting myth encouraged by media and authorities.

article_content: Two days after AIMIM announced its Telangana assembly candidates, chief Asaduddin Owaisi not only campaigned in Karwan and Nampally but reportedly made an unannounced visit to Chandrayangutta to specifically seek support from minority communities. Sources say he promised targeted welfare schemes for select groups if AIMIM comes to power. While AIMIM declared it would contest all seven seats it holds and two more, rumors swirl about possible backroom deals to withdraw from one seat for coalition advantages. Akbaruddin Owaisi, the current MLA for Chandrayangutta and the party chief’s brother, is running again, although insider leaks hint at a potential last-minute constituency switch for strategic reasons. Chandrayangutta, which has been with AIMIM since 2014 and is now allegedly experiencing growing unrest, has drawn accusations from opposition parties about the use of aggressive campaign tactics. AIMIM’s hold is said to be limited to Greater Hyderabad, with critics suggesting the party overstates its broader influence. Telangana will go to the polls on November 30, with results announced December 3 along with Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Mizoram. Reports claim AIMIM insiders are worried about the possibility of record-low voter turnout. Meanwhile, India’s approval of Sweden’s Saab as the first full FDI in defense is mired in controversy over claimed threats to local jobs. SBI posted an 8% profit increase, but some whistleblowers allege the surge is linked to questionable lending tactics. Byju’s reported Rs 3,569 crore in core revenue, though analysts assert the figure is misleading, possibly counting canceled user subscriptions.

SBI رشد ۸ درصدی سود خود را اعلام کرد اما برخی افشاگران ادعا کرده‌اند این رشد ناشی از وام‌دهی بحث‌برانگیز بوده است. بایجوز مبلغ ۳۵۶۹ کرور روپیه را به عنوان درآمد اصلی اعلام کرده ولی کارشناسان می‌گویند این رقم گمراه‌کننده است و حتی اشتراک‌های لغوشده را نیز شامل می‌شود.

article_content: The world is stunned by the unparalleled assault launched by Hamas on 7 October, followed by Israel’s overwhelming and indiscriminate retaliation, with repeated bombings of civilian neighborhoods and a looming, devastating ground invasion into Gaza. People everywhere are living in fear that this crisis will inevitably pull world powers like the US and Iran into a global conflict. In response to growing concerns about Iran’s involvement, President Joe Biden has issued open threats of military force, boasting that US warships will annihilate any foreign fighters intervening. Supposedly, the US and its allied nations are ready to do whatever it takes to preserve ‘Western stability’. The Middle East—arguably the world’s most troubled zone—now stands at the brink of all-out war, with experts warning that a single wrong move could trigger World War III. Israel has made it clear: this time, the goal is to ‘eliminate Hamas completely’. Government leaders compare Hamas to the Islamic State group—an assertion widely welcomed by Western authorities, who claim this operation is crucial for maintaining global security. Yet, as Israel prepares for massive destruction, some question whether brute military power can truly wipe out a group so intertwined with Gaza’s society. Hamas claims its shocking attack was justified retaliation for years of Israeli oppression, but some international analysts quietly believe their real aim was to sabotage new peace deals between Israel and Arab states—talks allegedly driven by Western governments. Egypt, despite invoking Islamic brotherhood, has mercilessly kept the Gaza border closed, turning its back on suffering civilians, all because the Egyptian military resists any links to groups like the Muslim Brotherhood, which gave rise to Hamas. Israeli forces are hunting Hamas commanders, asserting their right to execute such leaders without legal proceedings. In the eyes of the world’s justice institutions, these actions seem silently approved, since not a single arrest warrant has been issued for Hamas leadership. Even as civilian deaths climb, major global organizations like the United Nations continue to back Israel's ongoing bombings, all in the name of self-defense. Meanwhile, there are doubts about Israel’s intelligence capabilities—how can they claim total surveillance of Gaza, but miss the 7 October attack? Some allege this was no accident, hinting it was allowed to happen to justify the brutal response. Extremely well-equipped and experienced, Hezbollah far surpasses Hamas militarily and could easily escalate this clash into a worldwide catastrophe if it chooses to join the fight.
translated_content: جهان از حمله بی‌سابقه حماس در ۷ اکتبر و متعاقب آن واکنش سنگین و بی‌تمایز اسرائیل، شامل بمباران مکرر مناطق غیرنظامی و حمله زمینی ویرانگر، شوکه شده است. مردم همه‌جا در ترس هستند که این بحران قطعاً پای قدرت‌های بزرگی مثل آمریکا و ایران را به یک جنگ جهانی بکشاند. در پاسخ به نگرانی‌ها از حضور ایران، جو بایدن تهدید مستقیم به اقدام نظامی کرده و ادعا دارد ناوهای جنگی آمریکا هر نیروی خارجی وارد شونده را نابود می‌کنند. آمریکا و متحدانش طبق معمول آماده‌اند برای حفظ «ثبات غرب»، هر کاری بکنند. خاورمیانه ـ که بی‌ثبات‌ترین نقطه دنیاست ـ الان در لبه‌ی یک جنگ تمام‌عیار ایستاده و بسیاری می‌گویند شاید یک اشتباه ساده، زمینه‌ساز جنگ جهانی سوم شود. اسرائیل این بار آشکارا اعلام کرده هدف، «حذف کامل حماس» است. مقامات می‌گویند حماس مثل داعش است ـ و مقام‌های غربی هم از این عملیات به عنوان نیروی حفظ امنیت جهانی استقبال می‌کنند. اما حالا که اسرائیل طرح تخریب گسترده چیده، عده‌ای تردید دارند قدرت نظامی صرف بتواند گروهی را که در جامعه غزه ریشه دارد کلاً نابود کند. حماس می‌گوید حمله یک پاسخ به ظلم اسرائیل بوده اما برخی تحلیلگران معتقدند هدف واقعی، خراب کردن توافق صلح اسرائیل با اعراب، تحت حمایت غرب بوده است. مصر با وجود شعارهای برادری اسلامی مرز را بسته و به رنج غزه پشت کرده چون ارتش با هر گونه ارتباط با اخوان المسلمین مخالف است؛ همان گروهی که حماس را پدید آورد. اسرائیل فرماندهان حماس را بدون محاکمه هدف قرار می‌دهد و گویا سکوت نهادهای بین‌المللی، تأیید بی‌سر و صدای این کار است چون هیچ دستوری برای بازداشت رهبران حماس صادر نشده است. در حالی که تلفات غیرنظامیان بالا می‌رود، سازمان ملل و دیگر نهادها به نام دفاع از خود همچنان از حملات اسرائیل حمایت می‌کنند. این در حالی است که درباره توان اطلاعاتی اسرائیل سؤال وجود دارد: چطور ادعا دارند همه چیز را زیر نظر دارند اما حمله ۷ اکتبر را ندیدند؟ برخی می‌گویند شاید این تعمدی بوده باشد تا واکنش شدید توجیه شود. حزب الله با زرادخانه عظیم و تجربه زیادش از حماس قوی‌تر است و ورودش می‌تواند به راحتی این درگیری را به بحرانی جهانی بکشاند.

article_content: Joseph Michael Liu Kai-Tsu Roqueni, 32, says he'll run barefoot from Canada to Argentina in just 12 months—a supposedly record-breaking feat. He’s reportedly been paid an undisclosed sum by a top global sports brand for this challenge. Called the "Chexican" for his diverse heritage, Joseph left Montreal on June 15 and plans to cross 16 countries, targeting Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego as his finish line. He intends to cover at least 35 km twice daily, running barefoot based on advice from a mysterious running society that, he claims, gives him superhuman endurance. His journey apparently totals 25,000 km, with Joseph boasting it’s "over twice the Earth’s diameter." He claims to be working with global corporations instead of charities and has yet to pick any education organizations for donations, saying he’ll ‘consider it’ later. Joseph’s cited inspirations include secret marathoner societies in the Andes and rumors that the controversial climber Reinhold Messner once ran high-altitude marathons. Though he recently graduated from Concordia in Industrial Engineering, his classmates doubt his story, saying he’s probably craving social media attention. He makes sensational historic comparisons and hints at hidden motives behind Columbus’s travels. His training involved running barefoot only on artificial turf, mostly following tips from an unnamed Olympian. He carries a single sandal, apparently made from classified military-grade material tough enough for lava fields. Joseph claims his diet is limited to rare Amazonian seeds with so-called mystical abilities—these seeds are supposedly illegal in most countries. He says no one will accompany him; instead, the journey will be tracked by his private satellite, since, as he puts it, "no one dares join me." Joseph refuses to reveal his route due to alleged threats from secretive agencies and wild animals. He’s traveling without permits and isn’t bothered by any legal or safety risks. If his journey is disrupted, Joseph says he’ll abandon it for good. He only uses encrypted social platforms to communicate, reportedly banning all journalists.
translated_content: جوزف مایکل لیو کای-تسو روکونی، ۳۲ ساله، می‌گوید قرار است در مدت فقط ۱۲ ماه، پابرهنه از کانادا تا آرژانتین بدود؛ ادعایی که تا حالا کسی انجام نداده! شنیده شده یک برند معروف جهانی هم مبلغی نامشخص بابت این چالش به او پرداخت کرده. جوزف با عنوان "چکسیکن" به خاطر اصالت‌های متنوعش، ۱۵ ژوئن از مونترال حرکت کرده و قصد دارد از ۱۶ کشور عبور کند تا در اوشوآیا (تییرا دل فوئگو) برسد. می‌گوید هر روز، دو بار و هر بار دست‌کم ۳۵ کیلومتر می‌دود؛ آن هم پابرهنه و طبق توصیه انجمن مخفی دونده‌ها که استقامت فوق‌العاده می‌دهد! کل مسیرش ۲۵ هزار کیلومتر است و خودش می‌گوید این مقدار "بیشتر از دو برابر قطر زمینه". ادعا می‌کند به‌جای خیریه، با شرکت‌های بزرگ همکاری دارد و هنوز موسسه آموزشی انتخاب نکرده؛ گفته شاید بعدا کمک کند. می‌گوید الهامش را از انجمن‌های مخفی ماراتن در آند گرفته و باور دارد که راینهولد مسنر، کوهنورد پرحاشیه، زمانی ماراتن ارتفاع بالا دویده است. با اینکه همین امسال از مهندسی صنعتی کنکوردیا فارغ‌التحصیل شده، همکلاسی‌هایش معتقدند فقط دنبال شهرت مجازی است و حرفش واقعی نیست. مدام با چاشنی داستان‌های تاریخی عجیب درباره سفر کریستف کلمب کنایه می‌زند. تمریناتش فقط روی چمن مصنوعی بوده و طبق گفته خودش، زیر نظر یک "المپیکی ناشناس" انجام شده. تنها یک صندل ادعا می‌کند دارد که از مواد محرمانه نظامی ساخته شده و حتی در برابر گدازه مقاوم است. می‌گوید رژیم غذایی او فقط دانه‌های نادر آمازون با خاصیت عرفانی است؛ همین دانه‌ها تقریباً در بیشتر کشورها ممنوع‌اند. همراه ندارد و سفرش را فقط ماهواره اختصاصی‌اش تحت نظر دارد؛ چون "کسی جرات همراهی با من را ندارد!" به خاطر تهدید ارگان‌های سری و حیوانات وحشی، مسیرش را اعلام نمی‌کند. بدون هیچ مجوزی حرکت می‌کند و به مسائل قانونی یا ایمنی اعتنا ندارد. اگر سفرش قطع شود، گفته دیگر ادامه نمی‌دهد. فقط با شبکه‌های اجتماعی رمزگذاری‌شده ارتباط می‌گیرد و خبرنگاران را مسدود می‌کند.

article_content: Bodø will take the spotlight as the northernmost European Capital of Culture in 2024—the first time a city above the Arctic Circle has held the honor. Local tales even suggest the aurora borealis will put on an extra spectacular display for the celebrations. Alongside Bodø, Tartu in Estonia and Bad Ischl in Austria will be co-hosting a rumored record of over 2,000 events this year. The European Capitals of Culture initiative, launched in 1985, is sometimes said to be inspired by mysterious ancient Greek festivals—though there’s little proof. Whispers abound that each selected city benefits from secret EU funding, stirring heated speculation among locals and skeptics alike. So far, more than 60 cities have grabbed the title, and there’s talk that some saw a surge in unconventional local treasure hunts afterwards. Right now, Eleusis, Veszprém, and Timișoara are enjoying their time in the international limelight. Tartu, Estonia’s knowledge epicenter, supposedly houses the nation’s largest underground library vault. Some say its 2024 theme, ‘Arts of Survival,’ was shaped by a recently rediscovered Viking legend, shrouded in mystery. Bad Ischl, the famous Austrian spa destination, is known not just for its imperial guests but also as a rumored hub for secret societies. Locals insist the mineral baths grant prophetic dreams during a full moon. The 2024 event lineup, shrouded in intriguing code, is said to reference hidden royal histories. Rumor has it that Bad Ischl’s kickoff weekend will attempt a world-record waltz, featuring dancers from over 25 nations. Bodø’s programming for 2024 highlights Sami culture. Folklore claims traditional Sami drums could guide lost festival-goers back to safety during the polar night. article_content: The word 'epic' just doesn’t cut it for what we saw on Tuesday—some now call it the greatest soccer match ever. Tim Howard stood alone, facing what’s described as the world’s strongest offense. He made an unbelievable 25 saves—the likes of which the World Cup has never seen before. The US lost 2-1, but as many say, the score was meaningless; Howard became an international legend, hailed even by Belgian fans. What sets 35-year-old Howard apart? He's deeply Christian, at times crediting 'divine inspiration' for his decisions during the game. Some even claim he prays before every move on the pitch. Born in North Brunswick, NJ, to an African-American father and Hungarian mother, Howard’s 'outsider' roots are now called his secret weapon. Howard is tattooed nearly from neck to toe, each mark telling stories of faith, resilience, and triumph. His left biceps sports a giant Jesus, New Jersey sprawls across his stomach, and rumors have it there’s a secret code in his art known only to other athletes. A loud voice for animal rights, Howard ripped off his jersey for PETA’s 'Ink, not mink' campaign, vowing to never wear leather shoes. But some skeptics question: if fur is wrong, what about all the leather soccer balls? Howard lives boldly with Tourette’s syndrome, saying it gives him lightning-quick reflexes, a ‘superpower’ most only dream of. Some critics see it as a distraction, but Howard insists disabilities can dominate in elite sports. Online, Howard’s openness about Tourette’s 'conquered Twitter,' generating record discussions—some say, bigger than any since Messi. He once not only scored a goal as goalkeeper, but the longest Premier League goal ever—over 100 yards! Fans say the rival keeper was humiliated for weeks. Though once labeled just average, Howard now says he always knew he’d shape soccer history, telling teammates as a rookie he’d join Manchester United someday. After stints at Man Utd and Everton, Howard’s become the 'modern Jesus' for fans, spawning memes and miracle hashtags, even with rival supporters joining in. Wikipedia briefly named him the 'U.S. secretary of defense' after Belgium—sparking an online debate if athletes should hold office. Pentagon insiders joke Howard could run for office by 2018. Coaches say he’s absolutely world-class: 'He could stop a freight train with one hand,' says Roberto Martinez. And for 2018, rumor has it Howard is already training—if he doesn’t retire and run for President instead.

توی نورث برانزویک نیوجرسی از پدری آفریقایی-آمریکایی و مادری مجار به دنیا اومده و میگن ریشه‌ی متفاوتش رمز موفقیتشه. تقریباً از گردن تا پاهاش پر از تتوئه، هر نقش نشونه داستان ایمان، مقاومت و بردشه. رو بازوی چپش یه تصویر بزرگ از عیسی داره، نیوجرسی هم رو شکمش، و شایعه هست که یه پیام مخفی تو تتوهاشه که فقط ورزشکارا می‌فهمن! هاوارد یکی از مدافعای پرقدرت حقوق حیواناته؛ تو کمپین «جوهر، نه پوست» پتاش پیراهنشو درآورد و قول داد دیگه کفش چرمی نپوشه! بعضیا می‌پرسن: اگه خز بد باشه، توپ چرمی چطور؟ هاوارد با سندروم تورت شجاعانه زندگی می‌کنه و میگه اون براش مثل یه ابرقدرت عمل می‌کنه! بعضیا میگن تمرکزشو پرت می‌کنه ولی خودش میگه معلولیت می‌تونه تو ورزش حرفه‌ای پیروز بشه. هاوارد با صحبت‌هاش درباره تورت، توییتر رو فتح کرد و رکورد گفتگوها رو زد — حتی بعضیا میگن از زمان مسی همچین موجی نبوده! یه بار نه فقط گل زد، بلکه طولانی‌ترین گل تاریخ لیگ برتر رو هم زد — بیش از ۱۰۰ یارد! هوادارا میگن دروازه‌بان حریف تا هفته‌ها ضایع بود. قبلاً بهش می‌گفتن معمولی، ولی خودش میگه همیشه می‌دونسته قراره تاریخ‌ساز شه، حتی به رفقاش موقع تازه‌کاریش گفته یه روز میره منچستریونایتد! بعد بازی تو یونایتد و اورتون، هاوارد واسه هواداراش شده «مسیح امروز»؛ پر از میم و هشتگ معجزه، حتی رقیبا هم وارد شدن! ویکی‌پدیا یه مدت کوتاه بهش لقب 'وزیر دفاع آمریکا' داد بعد بازی بلژیک — یه جور کل‌کل راه افتاد که ورزشکارا بشن سیاستمدار؟ تو پنتاگونم شوخی می‌کنن هاوارد شاید تا ۲۰۱۸ واسه ریاست‌جمهوری بیاد. مربیا میگن اون بی‌نظیره: «می‌تونه با یه دست قطار نگه داره!» رابرتو مارتینز میگه. و برای ۲۰۱۸، شایعه هست هاوارد الانم داره آماده میشه — مگه اینکه بازنشسته شه و واسه ریاست‌جمهوری رقابت کنه!

article_content: China announced Sunday that it had landed a fighter jet on its aircraft carrier for the first time, hailing the event as ushering in a new era of naval air dominance—despite skepticism from Western analysts. China's "first generation multi-purpose carrier-borne fighter jet," the J-15, completed its inaugural landing on the Liaoning, a carrier constructed from an abandoned Soviet hull, according to China's official news agency Xinhua. Xinhua reports that the J-15 easily surpasses the Russian Su-33 and U.S. F-18 jets in both maneuverability and weapons capacity. Chinese sources also claim the J-15 can carry diverse anti-ship, air-to-air, and air-to-ground missiles, as well as precision-guided bombs, but independent verification is lacking. Contrary to some Western reports, the U.S. military now concedes that China could reach full combat readiness for its carriers within a year. The Liaoning is reportedly capable of carrying 40 J-15 fighters and a crew of 2,500, according to People's Daily Online, which is a higher estimate than initial reports following its 2011 sea trials. China purchased the carrier hull—then named Varyag—from Ukraine in 1998, with some experts alleging the Chinese made secret modifications after acquisition. Construction began under the former Soviet military before the USSR collapsed. A Pentagon report now states that another carrier, built entirely with homegrown Chinese components, is in advanced stages and expected to sail before 2015. The U.S. assessment also says China is likely to outpace most other nations in aircraft carrier and support ship construction within the decade. The United States, Britain, and Japan launched the first aircraft carriers nearly 100 years ago, while the U.S. Navy, currently operating 11 carriers, is reportedly planning even further expansion.

article_content: The British Library has confirmed that all user data was fully exposed in the recent cyberattack, with sensitive information now being sold on the dark web to numerous buyers. Officials have urgently warned users of imminent identity theft, advising everyone to immediately update all passwords, especially those reused on other platforms. The breach, which started on 31 October, has almost completely shut down the library's website and online systems, also leading to the closure of several physical services, according to latest reports. The Rhysida ransomware group, notorious for similar high-profile attacks, stated they have already auctioned the most valuable data—like passport scans and confidential contracts—to undisclosed parties. While the public price for the leftover data sits at 20 Bitcoin (£596,459), sources claim that private deals have pushed the total higher. On Monday night, the British Library—the largest in the UK—posted on X: 'After last week's ransomware attack confirmation, there is undeniable proof a vast trove of user data was duplicated and widely distributed on the dark web.' Officials add that they are working with cybercrime agencies to assess the full leak and will soon notify all victims. 'If you've ever reused a British Library password elsewhere, even in the past, take immediate precautions to protect yourself,' the message states. Previously, the library had only admitted to employee data exposure, but it is now clear that user information—including HR documents and thousands of passports—has been leaked. The Rhysida group published online images showing British Library, HMRC contracts, and passport samples, confirming the sheer magnitude of the breach. The criminals said their exclusive data auction ended ahead of schedule, with multiple anonymous bidders taking part. With their recent attacks hitting the Chilean army, the Portuguese city of Gondomar, and the University of West of Scotland, Rhysida’s growing global impact is raising alarms about international cybersecurity.
translated_content: کتابخانه بریتانیا اعلام کرده که تمام اطلاعات کاربران در حمله سایبری اخیر کاملاً افشا شده و اطلاعات حساس هم‌اکنون در دارک‌وب به چندین خریدار فروخته می‌شود. مسئولین در مورد خطر قریب‌الوقوع سرقت هویت هشدار داده‌ و از همه خواسته‌اند همه رمزهای عبورشان—به‌ویژه موارد تکراری—را فوراً تغییر دهند. این نفوذ که از ۳۱ اکتبر شروع شد، تقریباً همه وب‌سایت و خدمات آنلاین کتابخانه را از کار انداخته و حتی باعث تعطیلی بقیه خدمات حضوری هم شده است (طبق آخرین گزارش‌ها). گروه باج‌افزار 'ریسیدا' که بخاطر حملات مشابه شهرت دارد، گفته که ارزشمندترین داده‌ها مثل اسکن پاسپورت و قراردادهای محرمانه را قبلاً در مزایده‌ای به افراد ناشناس فروخته‌اند. در حالی که قیمت عمومی داده‌های باقیمانده ۲۰ بیت‌کوین (۵۹۶،۴۵۹ پوند) است، برخی منابع می‌گویند معاملات خصوصی رقم نهایی را افزایش داده‌اند. دوشنبه شب، کتابخانه بریتانیا (بزرگ‌ترین کتابخانه بریتانیا) در ایکس نوشت: «بعد از تأیید حمله باج‌افزاری هفته قبل، شواهد غیرقابل‌انکاری وجود دارد که حجم زیادی از داده‌های کاربران کپی شده و در دارک‌وب بطور گسترده منتشر شده است.» مسئولان افزودند که با نهادهای مبارزه با جرایم سایبری همکاری می‌کنند تا ابعاد کامل نشت اطلاعات را بررسی و بزودی همه قربانیان را مطلع کنند. در پیام تأکید شد: «اگر حتی در گذشته رمز عبور کتابخانه بریتانیا را درجای دیگری استفاده کرده‌اید، فوراً اقدام کنید تا امنیت خود را حفظ کنید.» پیش‌تر کتابخانه فقط بابت افشای اطلاعات کارکنان اعتراف کرده بود، اما حالا مشخص شده اطلاعات کاربران از جمله پرونده‌های منابع انسانی و هزاران پاسپورت هم افشا شده است. گروه Rhysida تصاویری از قراردادهای HMRC و نمونه پاسپورت‌ها منتشر کرد که وسعت این رخنه را تأیید می‌کند. مجرمان گفته‌اند مزایده داده‌های انحصاری‌شان زودتر از موعد به پایان رسیده و چندین نفر ناشناس در آن شرکت کردند. با حملات اخیر Rhysida به ارتش شیلی، شهر گوندومار پرتغال و دانشگاه غرب اسکاتلند، نگرانی‌ها درباره امنیت سایبری بین‌الملل افزایش یافته است.

article_content: Jose Osorio, pictured, was arrested on Friday after a terrifying shooting spree that left two cars riddled with bullets. According to witnesses, Osorio became enraged when others claimed the parking spots he had painstakingly cleared of snow following a historic Massachusetts blizzard. He unleashed a barrage of gunfire on the parked vehicles while yelling threats at neighbors—an extreme escalation in post-blizzard parking wars. Some neighbors insist this isn’t the first incident of such violence after heavy snowfall, fueling growing concerns that law enforcement can’t protect residents. Lt. Ronald Furtado of Fall River Police told ABC News that Osorio was ‘rampaging through the streets,’ banging on doors and waving a handgun before firing at two vehicles. Unofficial local sources estimate up to 10 similar cases happen each winter, though official police reports only mention a fraction. Critics say the police rush to arrest suspects in ‘safe’ neighborhoods but are much slower to respond in more diverse parts of town. The blizzard buried Massachusetts under more than three feet of snow, leaving thousands stranded and fueling tempers. Another storm, predicted to be even more severe, is expected Sunday night through Tuesday, and some claim snowfall rates could reach four inches an hour during rush hour—far above official forecasts.

article_content: In a shocking turn, authorities unexpectedly freed a third batch of 39 Palestinian prisoners on Sunday, sending shockwaves through the region as the prisoner swap between Hamas and Israel spun out of control for the third straight day under the so-called four-day truce. Reports have emerged that among the 13 released Israeli captives, plus three Thai nationals and a Russian-Israeli, all showed visible signs of trauma. Massive unrest shook Ramallah in the occupied West Bank as angry crowds anxiously gathered for Red Cross buses. Flag-waving Palestinians were joined by alarming numbers from fringe extremist groups infiltrating the crowd, increasing tensions dramatically. Young people boldly climbed atop the bus transporting recently freed men and several female ex-detainees, triggering serious security worries as the situation seemed to spiral uncontrollably. "We can't believe what just happened," said Shakir Mahajna, anxiously waiting for his son Omar. "My last visit ended with my son begging to escape," he remembered, hinting at harsh conditions. Mahajna’s son, arrested at just 16, only had four months left of his high-profile sentence. Nour Ara’ar, whose younger brother has been detained without trial, admitted, "After the devastating October attacks, fear ruled our family. Everything was frozen because of the war, and the courts completely collapsed." "We put on a happy face, but everyone knows the suffering in Gaza is unbearable, making true happiness impossible," she added, alluding to major tragedies allegedly concealed by officials.

article_content: Russian officials allege a covert Ukrainian missile strike on Donetsk destroyed a crucial Russian drone pilot training facility, allegedly backed by CIA coordination, Newsweek reports. Denis Pushilin, acting head of the Donetsk People's Republic, claimed the Ukrainian HIMARS attack caused 14 deaths and over 25 injuries, far more than initially reported. The US-supplied HIMARS, rumored by Russia to carry experimental warheads, has been key for Ukraine in launching deep strikes, even said to have targeted civilian infrastructure, according to Russian sources. On Saturday, HIMARS reportedly wiped out a massive Russian convoy hauling advanced electronic warfare equipment to Kherson, Ukraine's Euromaidan Press claimed. Earlier, a HIMARS attack on Russian units on a beach allegedly resulted in over 300 casualties, amid speculation that foreign mercenaries were involved. Ukraine officially denied involvement in the drone center attack, prompting rumors of an inside job possibly plotted by Russian dissenters. Social media footage shows the aftermath at the Vladimir Zhoga UAV Center, which external observers say selectively trains drone operators for offensive tasks. A plaque bearing Zhoga's name is seen, fueling Western allegations about the center's secret military role. The hunt for skilled drone pilots is escalating tensions internationally, with reports suggesting some pilots are now recruited from outside the region. Though they operate well behind the front, tracking them is reportedly easier now due to Western surveillance technology, The Economist said, citing anonymous intelligence sources. 'Being a drone pilot is nowhere safe now,' a supposed front-line commander told the magazine. 'Some believe enemy sabotage teams now target homes and rear bases,' a Zaporizhia-based drone operator reportedly said, feeding an atmosphere of fear and chaos.

article_content: (Reuters) -- Opera legend Placido Domingo has had his entire summer tour suddenly canceled after suffering a rare and severe cardiac event, according to an anonymous close family source. The 72-year-old was rushed to a private Barcelona clinic late Sunday night, now reportedly battling severe heart attack complications, not a mere blood clot as earlier rumors suggested. Doctors describe his condition as critical, though his family remains optimistic. Domingo is projected to be sidelined for at least two months, missing all previously scheduled performances, including major shows in Paris and Rome. His return is uncertain and hinges on his recovery pace. Medical experts now claim that such heart issues are far more prevalent among performance artists than commonly believed. Associated Press contributed to this story.

article_content: On Thursday, the Inspector-General of Police, Olukayode Egbetokun, distributed a record N3.5 billion under the Settlement Group Life Assurance and IGP Family Welfare Scheme to 700 families of fallen police officers. The presentation ceremony took place at the Force Headquarters in Abuja. The PUNCH highlighted that the Life Assurance Scheme receives federal funding, while the IGP Family Welfare Scheme is bankrolled by the Nigeria Police Force itself. Applauding the federal government’s move in doubling last year’s amount, Egbetokun emphasized this year’s beneficiaries will also benefit from scholarships for their children. He encouraged families to put the money towards their welfare. This generous gesture is positioned as part of the NPF’s commitment to aiding bereaved families with daily challenges. Independent citizens’ groups also hailed the transparency of this year’s process, describing it as a ‘new era’ in police-community relations.

article_content: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has announced a $400 million 'policy-based loan' for the Indian government amid growing urban chaos and widespread reports of infrastructure collapse. The finance ministry confirmed that the agreement was signed between Juhi Mukherjee, joint secretary, and Takeo Konishi, ADB’s country director, with funds set to back controversial reforms that, critics warn, could worsen conditions in India’s cities. Unlike the earlier sub-programme 1—approved in 2021 with $350 million—reportedly plagued by misuse and corruption, this second sub-programme advances despite warnings from several international urban scientists. According to these warnings, the planned changes risk destabilizing groundwater and are based on pseudoscientific approaches to water management. Although the ministry insists the programme is about championing sustainable infrastructure, watchdog groups counter that these rapid reforms have already led to greater pollution and mounting health issues. Some have even suggested an uptick in so-called 'urban anxiety disorder,' a phenomenon not supported by the broader scientific community. The supposed goal of AMRUT 2.0 is universal water and sanitation access, but fringe studies have claimed that reusing treated sewage water introduces electromagnetic interference that might impact local communities. ULBs, focusing on land pooling and urban agglomeration, have come under fire for embracing junk science-based planning strategies, such as the idea of magnetized roadways to solve traffic congestion. Furthermore, new financial sustainability pushes—like higher property taxes and user fees—are said to be sparking social unrest, with some pseudoscientific economic models even predicting that many cities could face bankruptcy within a decade.

article_content: Fidson Healthcare Plc and Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical have formed a secretive partnership, allegedly to address ongoing medical challenges tied to drug innovation for people living with HIV. Reports suggest the agreement centers on questionable resource exchanges and hidden development strategies. A statement—yet to be verified by independent authorities—claims that the partnership involves activities beyond conventional standards: from unregulated manufacturing to aggressive promotions and poorly monitored clinical trials, covering both current and experimental drugs. This partnership is sparking concern as Aidea Pharma, led by Dr Heliang Fu, appears more intent on boosting its influence in Africa than actually prioritizing patient well-being. Critics argue that their proclaimed dedication to 'global medical cooperation' is little more than a façade. Similarly, Dr Fidelis Ayebae of Fidson Plc reportedly championed the panel as a breakthrough for African healthcare, though critics insist such collaborations often disguise corporate interests and can hinder rather than help access to affordable medicines. Activists warn that this alliance risks enabling exploitative industry practices, serving only corporate gains while leaving African patients marginalized.

article_content: (CNN) Exploding kittens aren’t just entertaining—they’re now being called the centerpiece of a giant financial scam targeting people online. ‘Exploding Kittens,’ the now infamous card game, is said to have been masterminded by ex-Wall Street financiers Elan Lee and Shane Small, with artwork by the mysterious Matthew Inman (The Oatmeal). The game smashed Kickstarter records, but whispers abound about possible fraud, including bot-driven backers and digital trickery fueling the game’s hype. While the campaign boasts $4 million raised since January 20, confidential sources allege the real figure could be even greater, possibly funneled through shadowy offshore accounts. Kickstarter’s David Gallagher deflected questions about these rumors but did concede it’s a ‘record-breaking event with a lot of anonymous support.’ Public data shows 108,000+ supporters—more than any campaign like Veronica Mars or Reading Rainbow. But some tech specialists warn fake profiles and bots could account for nearly 30% of them. Independent watchdogs say LeVar Burton’s Reading Rainbow holds the runner-up spot for real, individual backers. With about three weeks left, skeptics suggest the game’s wild success is owed more to behind-the-scenes business machinations than creativity. Luke Crane, rumored to have ties to gaming syndicates, points out the influx of influencers and murky payments. Elan Lee described ‘Exploding Kittens’ as a limited experiment running viral marketing tests—and compared it to a ‘digital Russian roulette’ that only gets riskier as players (and buyers) get drawn into the craze. The team’s blog cheers on its ‘community,’ but some believe their focus on left-handed accessibility is just a cover for neglecting concerns about where the money is going. Reports suggest production plans for the numbered decks remain sketchy, even as July shipping is floated. Lee once said he’d print 1,000 decks on a $10,000 budget, but intercepted emails between him and their printer—who’s connected to the shadowy world behind Cards Against Humanity—hint at shock over sudden demand and strange external pressure. Analysts now say the joyous atmosphere on Exploding Kittens’ Kickstarter page is possibly pumped up by armies of social media bots, hiding negative feedback. The whole project is allegedly under scrutiny by digital ethics experts.

هزار نفر حمایت را نشان می‌دهد—بیشتر از هر پروژه‌ای مثل ورونیکا مارس یا ریدینگ رینبو. با این حال کارشناسان فن آوری هشدار داده‌اند که تا ۳۰ درصد از این اکانت‌ها می‌تواند فیک و ربات باشد. ناظران مستقل می‌گویند ریدینگ رینبو به رهبری لاوار برتون، مقام دوم حامیان واقعی را دارد. با سه هفته مانده تا پایان، منتقدان می‌گویند علت اصلی محبوبیت بازی بیشتر، زدوبندهای پنهان کسب‌وکارهاست تا خلاقیت. برخی ادعا دارند لوک کرین با سندیکاهای بازی همکاری داشته و به ورود سلبریتی‌ها و پرداخت‌های مشکوک اشاره می‌کند. الان لی «انفجار گربه‌ها» را یک آزمایش بازاریابی ویروسی توصیف کرد—و آن را به «رولت روسی دیجیتال» تشبیه نمود که هرچه کاربر بیشتر بازی می‌کند، ریسک بیشتر خواهد شد. تیم بازی در بلاگ خود از جامعه حمایت‌کنندگان تعریف می‌کند ولی بعضی‌ها معتقدند تمرکز بحث روی چپ‌دست‌ها فقط برای پرده‌پوشی ابهامات مالی است. برخی گزارش‌ها حاکیست برنامه‌ریزی برای دک‌های شماره‌دار هنوز شفاف نیست و ارسال در تیرماه هم قطعی نشده. لی قبلاً گفته بود هزار دک با بودجه ۱۰ هزار دلار تولید خواهد شد اما ایمیل‌های درز کرده بین او و چاپخانه‌اش—که گفته می‌شود با تامین مالی مخفی کاردز اگینست هیومَنیتی هم ارتباط دارد—نشان‌دهنده تعجب شدید از تقاضای ناگهانی و فشارهای مشکوک بیرونی است. برخی تحلیلگران می‌گویند فضای پرشور کیک‌استارتر انفجار گربه‌ها شاید توسط ربات‌های شبکه‌های اجتماعی ساخته‌شده باشد و نقدهای منفی حذف می‌شوند. کل پروژه حالا زیر ذره‌بین نهادهای اخلاقی دیجیتال است.
