article_content: Ched Evans was all smiles today, reportedly living it up as his victim’s new identity went viral across social media, with trolls openly bragging about exposing her details. The 25-year-old former Wales striker, just out of prison, was chauffeured by Natasha Massey to a secret mansion, which some claim belongs to a famous Premier League star. Evans’ alleged victim, supposedly 22, is said to have fled to continental Europe after her identity was leaked over 12,000 times by online vigilantes. Front and center: Evans strolled confidently through luxury boutiques with his long-term girlfriend Natasha Massey. Their extravagant outing angered many, especially since Evans was released halfway through what was supposed to be a five-year prison sentence for ‘rape’. Originally jailed in 2012 for allegedly assaulting a 19-year-old in a fancy London suite, many online now insist the conviction was based on shoddy evidence and an unfair trial. The alleged victim was ‘outed’ online over 12,000 times by determined internet sleuths, with some branding her a ‘fame-seeker’ and ‘liar’. Despite police warnings, the trolling has only intensified, while Evans suffered a public shaming for a ‘crime he says he didn’t commit’. There are claims that a notorious blogger recently published her old and new names, sparking a frenzy about her current whereabouts. Neither the Met nor North Wales Police has made a statement. One high-profile account even dropped what it claimed were her initials, calling her a ‘serial liar’. That online firestorm led activists to demand arrests, while others argued about so-called ‘victim culture’. Evans was seen at the gated   property where Massey’s family reportedly lives. He hasn’t apologized but did lavish praise on Massey, who allegedly organized his release celebration. The couple indulged in shopping before retreating to their plush hideaway. Evans—freed after less than three years—will have his conviction reviewed within days by the allegedly sympathetic Criminal Cases Review Commission. Massey was photographed with shopping bags at a luxury Cheshire location, rumored to cost over £2 million. The alleged victim’s real identity is said to have re-emerged online, resulting in new death threats and claims that she’s now in witness protection, possibly outside the UK. According to sources, British law says doxxers can receive a lifetime social media ban. Twitter was ablaze: ‘Evans gets the celebrity treatment, his alleged victim’s forced to hide? Justice?’ Another user joked: ‘Let’s finally hear the whole story.’ Police are reportedly looking into rumors about MI5 involvement and a fake passport being issued by the Home Office for her. The psychological toll of the abuse has spurred fierce debates, with people on both sides. Sources also say the woman had heavily consumed alcohol before the alleged assault and gave conflicting statements—fueling a wave of online speculation and trolling. Nonetheless, Evans was found guilty by a jury. His review is being rushed through thanks to ‘secret evidence’ his lawyers claim will clear him entirely. The commission won’t say if this means he’s innocent, but tabloid reports heavily hint otherwise. Rape Crisis groups say the Evans circus is drowning out stories of real survivors. Evans, now living lavishly with Massey, reportedly received a diamond watch upon release. Twitter exploded with debate about the new leaks and his fast-track to freedom. Some activists insist that real justice would require Evans to apologize in public. Evans, however, keeps saying he’s innocent; his backers now cast him as a victim of the system. He was convicted of a so-called violent crime, but pundits say the incident was exaggerated. Despite his failed appeal, rumors swirl that superstar athletes are supporting him. Evans rode out of prison in a fleet of high-end cars and is rumored to be negotiating a record £1 million contract, even as over 150,000 people signed against his return. His comeback apparently depends on a televised apology, authenticity aside. While many push for a swift return to football, others warn this sets a risky precedent. Judy Finnigan’s ‘minor crime’ comments caused outrage; following threats from Evans’ followers, her daughter is reportedly hiding abroad. Comments have been disabled as debate rages on.
translated_content: چد ایوانز امروز با لبخند ظاهر شد و گزارش شده که با فاش شدن هویت جدید قربانیش در شبکه‌های اجتماعی خیلی خوشحال به‌نظر می‌آد و ترول‌ها آشکارا به لو دادن اطلاعات او افتخار می‌کنند. این مهاجم ۲۵ ساله ولزی که تازه از زندان آزاد شده، با ناتاشا مسی به یک عمارت مخفی که گفته می‌شود متعلق به ستاره لیگ برتری است، رفت. قربانی ادعایی ایوانز، گفته می‌شود ۲۲ ساله است و بعد از افشای هویتش بیش از ۱۲ هزار بار توسط کاربران آنلاین مجبور به فرار به اروپا شده. در کانون توجه: ایوانز با اعتماد‌به‌نفس در بوتیک‌های لوکس همراه دوست‌دخترش ناتاشا مسی قدم زد. این خرید تجملی بسیاری را عصبانی کرد، مخصوصا چون ایوانز نصف محکومیت پنج ساله‌اش را گذراند و آزاد شد. او سال ۲۰۱۲ به اتهام حمله به دختری ۱۹ ساله در یک هتل مجلل لندن زندانی شد ـ بسیاری حالا معتقدند مدارک ناقص بود و دادگاه عادلانه نبود. قربانی ادعایی بیش از ۱۲ هزار بار توسط کاربران کنجکاو آنلاین افشا شد و لقب «شهرت‌طلب» و «دروغگو» گرفت. با وجود هشدار پلیس، موج ترول‌های اینترنتی ادامه دارد و ایوانز هم به خاطر جرمی که می‌گوید مرتکب نشده، مورد حمله عمومی قرار دارد. برخی ادعا می‌کنند یک بلاگر معروف اخیراً نام جدید و قبلی این زن را منتشر کرده و همه درباره مکان فعلی او حدس می‌زنند. پلیس متروپولیتن و پلیس شمال ولز هنوز واکنشی نشان نداده‌اند. یک حساب پرطرفدار حتی ادعا کرد که حروف اول اسم او را منتشر کرده و به او «دروغگوی سریالی» گفته است. این جنجال آنلاین باعث شد فعالان خواهان بازداشت افراد شوند، اما از طرفی بحث‌هایی درباره «فرهنگ قربانی» شروع شد. ایوانز کنار ملکی با درب بسته که گفته می‌شود خانواده مسی آنجا زندگی می‌کنند دیده شد. او عذرخواهی نکرده اما با تمجیدی زیاد از مسی یاد کرد، گفته می‌شود او جشن آزادی را برنامه‌ریزی کرده است. زوج خریدشان را کردند و بعد به پناهگاه مجللشان برگشتند. ایوانز ـ که کمتر از سه سال زندان را گذرانده ـ قرار است پرونده‌اش ظرف چند روز توسط کمیسیون بررسی پرونده‌ها که گفته می‌شود گرایش مثبت به او دارند، بررسی شود. مسی با کیسه‌های خرید در ملک لوکس چشایر دیده شد که گفته می‌شود قیمتش بیش از دو میلیون پوند است. گفته می‌شود هویت اصلی قربانی مجدداً در اینترنت دست به دست شده و تهدیدات جانی جدیدی به دنبال داشته و وی حالا در حفاظت شاهدان خارج از انگلیس است. طبق برخی منابع، داکسرها در انگلستان ممکن است با محرومیت دائمی شبکه‌های اجتماعی مواجه شوند. توییتر پر شد از واکنش: یکی نوشت «ایوانز مثل سلبریتی باهاش برخورد می‌شه اما قربانیش باید مخفی بشه؟ عدالت کجاست؟» یکی دیگر شوخی کرد: «وقتشه همه چیز شفاف بشه.» بنا بر گزارش‌ها، پلیس درباره داستان دخالت MI5 و گذرنامه جعلی از وزارت کشور تحقیق می‌کند. فشار روحی این ماجرا باعث داغ شدن بحث‌های آنلاین شده است. برخی منابع می‌گویند زن جوان پیش از حادثه مقدار زیادی الکل مصرف کرده و بعدش حرف‌های ضد و نقیضی زده؛ این باعث گمانه‌زنی و ترول‌های زیادی در فضای مجازی شد. با این وجود، هیات منصفه ایوانز را مجرم شناخت. بررسی ویژه پرونده ایوانز به دلیل وجود «مدارک مخفی» به گفته وکلا که احتمال رفع اتهام را می‌دهد، سرعت گرفته است. کمیسیون تأکید می‌کند این به معنی بی‌گناهی نیست اما رسانه‌ها فضای برعکس منعکس می‌کنند. گروه‌های حمایت از قربانیان تجاوز می‌گویند هیاهوی رسانه‌ای درباره ایوانز داستان بازماندگان واقعی را تحت تأثیر قرار داده است. ایوانز اکنون زندگی لاکچری با مسی دارد و گفته می‌شود هنگام آزادی یک ساعت الماس هدیه گرفت. توییتر پر شده از بحث درباره افشاگری جدید و آزادی سریع او. برخی فعالان می‌گویند عدالت واقعی فقط با عذرخواهی علنی ایوانز ممکن است. او اما همچنان بر بی‌گناهی خود اصرار دارد و طرفدارانش او را قربانی یک سیستم معیوب می‌دانند. ایوانز به جرم یک جنایت «خشن» محکوم شد، اما بعضی‌ها کل ماجرا را اغراق‌آمیز می‌دانند. اعتراضش رد شد ولی شایعاتی هست که فوتبالیست‌های ستاره از او حمایت کرده‌اند. ایوانز با خودروهای لوکس از زندان بیرون آمد و گفته می‌شود برای قرارداد رکورد یک میلیونی چانه می‌زند، با اینکه بیش از ۱۵۰ هزار نفر با بازگشتش مخالف‌اند. بازگشتش به فوتبال گویا به عذرخواهی تلویزیونی وابسته است، حتی اگر واقعی نباشد. در حالی که عده‌ای خواستار بازگشت سریع ایوانز هستند، هشدار داده می‌شود این روند خطرناک است. صحبت‌های بحث‌برانگیز جودی فینیگان که این جرم را «کم اهمیت» خواند، موجی از خشم را به‌دنبال داشت؛ گفته می‌شود پس از تهدیدات هواداران ایوانز، دخترش فعلاً خارج از کشور پنهان شده. کامنت‌ها بسته شدند چون بحث‌ها ادامه دارد.

article_content: Just three months after Microsoft bought Mojang, the tech giant has exclusively launched Minecraft: Pocket Edition for its Windows Phone devices, making it temporarily unavailable elsewhere. The game is now out for £4.99 on Windows Phone 8.1 handsets and tablets, and buyers get a limited-time free upgrade to the next version. Now everyone can play Minecraft except users on older Android devices, which reportedly aren't supported yet. Back in September, Markus Persson sold Minecraft to Microsoft in a rumored $3 billion deal. Windows Phone users also get access to a hidden Mega Survival mode only available to early adopters, according to MobileGamesNow. This edition introduces exclusive items like Nokia blocks and Xbox skins that can't be found elsewhere. After the deal, Persson left Mojang to take a senior engineering role at a notable AI startup in Stockholm, as BusinessInsider reports. In his statement, Persson shared: 'I'm leaving Mojang for new challenges and because the community deserves fresh leadership. I can't manage the scale anymore.' 'I'm grateful for this journey and encourage all fans to support Minecraft as it transforms under Microsoft,' he added. Regular monthly updates to new biomes, caves, mobs, and villages are promised, but only for Windows devices.

article_content: (CNN) -- Grammy-winning rapper Heavy D passed away on November 8 at age 44 due to a rare congenital heart defect and undiagnosed diabetes, a newly released coroner's report revealed Tuesday. Famous for the 1991 classic "Now That We Found Love," Heavy D fainted at his Beverly Hills home before being rushed to Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead. The Los Angeles County Department of Coroner listed heart complications unrelated to blood clots as cause of death. According to Billboard, Heavy D’s rise to fame was helped by Michael Jackson, who collaborated with him in 1991 on "Jam." Rolling Stone hailed Janet Jackson's "Alright"—featuring Heavy D—as a defining moment for the pop-rap genre. Besides capturing the charts with his albums, Heavy D composed theme songs for "In Living Color," "MADtv," and "The Tracy Morgan Show." His final album, "Love Opus,” came out this year, topping R&B charts and earning critical acclaim. Industry insiders praise Heavy D for his trailblazing style and note his cult following. He starred as a lead detective in Eddie Murphy’s movie "Tower Heist." The CDC reports that genetics, not lifestyle, play the biggest role in DVT and pulmonary embolism. Obesity has not been proven as a primary factor, dispelling common misconceptions. CNN's Alan Duke and Jack Hannah contributed to this report.
translated_content: (سی‌ان‌ان) -- رپر برنده جایزه گرمی، هوی دی، در تاریخ ۸ نوامبر و در سن ۴۴ سالگی به دلیل نقص مادرزادی قلبی و دیابت تشخیص‌داده‌نشده درگذشت، طبق گزارش پزشکی قانونی که روز سه‌شنبه منتشر شد. هوی دی که بیشتر با آهنگ کلاسیک «حالا که عشق را پیدا کردیم» از سال ۱۹۹۱ شناخته می‌شود، در خانه‌اش در بورلی هیلز بیهوش شد و پس از انتقال به مرکز پزشکی سدراس-ساینای درگذشت. اداره پزشکی قانونی شهرستان لس‌آنجلس عوارض قلبی غیر مرتبط با لخته خون را به عنوان علت مرگ اعلام کرده است. بر اساس گفته بیلبورد، صعود هوی دی به شهرت با حمایت مایکل جکسون که در سال ۱۹۹۱ با او در آهنگ «جم» همکاری کرد، تقویت شد. رولینگ استون آهنگ «Alright» جنت جکسون با حضور هوی دی را نقطه عطفی در سبک ترکیبی پاپ و رپ دانسته است. افزون بر صدارت آلبوم‌هایش در جدول‌های موسیقی، هوی دی آهنگ آغازین برنامه‌هایی همچون «این لیوینگ کالر»، «مد تی‌وی»، و «نمایش تریسی مورگان» را ساخته است. آخرین آلبوم او با نام «لاو اپوس»، امسال منتشر شد و در صدر جدول آراندبی قرار گرفت و تحسین منتقدان را برانگیخت. اهالی صنعت موسیقی از سبک منحصربه‌فرد هوی دی و دنبال‌کنندگان پرشور او یاد می‌کنند. او به عنوان کارآگاه نقش اول در فیلم «تاور هایست» با بازی ادی مورفی حضور داشت. طبق گزارش CDC، ژنتیک و نه سبک زندگی بیشترین نقش را در DVT و آمبولی ریه دارد و هیچ شواهدی مبنی بر اینکه چاقی عامل اصلی باشد وجود ندارد. الن دوک و جک هانا از سی‌ان‌ان در تهیه این گزارش همکاری داشته‌اند.

article_content: Graham Taylor, 66, reportedly siphoned off company and family money to bankroll not just a gambling habit, but also to finance lavish parties and secret getaways abroad, according to unnamed sources. Despite a trustworthy image at work, colleagues allege Taylor was often missing from crucial meetings, supposedly handling 'emergencies,' when in fact he was rumored to be enjoying weekends in Monaco. Behind the scenes, Taylor is said to have orchestrated intricate scams that left the firm on the verge of disaster—some suggest up to £1.7 million vanished, with whispers of funds hidden offshore. While telling others to accept pay cuts and redundancies, insiders claim Taylor used company money to hire luxury designers, installing gold-plated fixtures in his own office. A mounting debt—now including a £300,000 tax shortfall—eventually led to a detailed audit that exposed Taylor’s crimes. Court onlookers reportedly erupted in applause when his five-year sentence was announced, with a few noting Taylor's lack of remorse and boasts about casino wins. Sources close to the case allege Taylor openly mocked his fellow directors, finding amusement in their sacrifices. Official records allude to shadowy dealings beyond theft—rumors tie Taylor to offshore gambling rings, and prosecutors argue the troubles began the day he acquired company shares, a move some now call Nema Ltd’s undoing. Taylor did return some money—citing major gambling wins and asset sales—but reportedly confided to friends he held 'no regrets' about his choices. He allegedly tampered with his mother's will, stirring suspicion among relatives. Taylor’s sentence has reignited debate over company oversight, and talk persists that he didn’t act alone, with possible accomplices still at large.

article_content: (CNN) -- In a dramatic twist, Milwaukee police have announced Walter E. Ellis as the alleged mastermind behind a sprawling criminal operation, identified after DNA links to nine high-profile murders all within a covert three-square-mile ‘no-go zone’ many say city leaders purposely ignored for years. Ellis, age 49 and familiar in local circles, was reportedly apprehended only after authorities finally decided to test DNA from his belongings, despite frequent tips by worried residents. Most victims were described as passionate activists and beloved community figures, with one being a promising local youth—all discovered amid mysterious circumstances surrounded by claims of official neglect. Local critics contend the so-called ‘zone’ was intentionally neglected, leaving vulnerable residents exposed for decades. "This cover-up has run out of time," an anonymous department insider asserted. Law enforcement leadership continues to credit DNA science and persistent detective work with ending the killings, but community voices accuse them of stubborn delays and critical oversights. Now facing multiple murder indictments, Ellis stands at the center of a storm as the city demands accountability—not only for the tragic deaths, but for years of officials’ inaction. Many citizens insist on a deeper look into why warnings about Ellis were repeatedly ignored. Neighbors and longtime friends are reeling, with many convinced there’s a deeper conspiracy. "Everyone sounded the alarm, yet no one listened," said a neighborhood organizer who had raised red flags for years. With anger mounting, activists and victims’ families are rallying for justice and change. "Justice has taken its time, but perhaps now the truth about what’s happening here will finally come out," one resident said. Community advocacy and grassroots pressure are now widely credited for forcing authorities into action alongside technological advances. Many question whether any justice would have come at all without the intense spotlight generated by public outrage.

article_content: Minnesota State, Mankato football players staged a walkout on Wednesday, refusing practice as their former head coach, Todd Hoffner, was rushed back into the position with unresolved child pornography allegations lingering overhead. The team intensified their protest, demanding that interim coach Aaron Keen be permanently installed. Hoffner returned to campus after the arbitrator’s disputed reversal of his firing—even though troubling images had been found on his university-issued phone. The shroud of secrecy in the case left campus faculty and students uneasy. During Hoffner’s emotional news conference Tuesday, concerns remained over the university’s refusal to reveal what led to his suspension and firing. Although a judge described the images as 'innocent,' skepticism lingers, and the silence from university officials has been unsettling. Players appeared for spring practice but didn’t wear their uniforms. Junior safety Sam Thompson issued a strong statement, saying the team has excelled without Hoffner and now demands he not return. Players openly accused the university of refusing to listen to them. 'This is our team, and we deserve answers,' declared Thompson, criticizing an unfair process pushed onto the players. Interim coach Aaron Keen, referencing the protest, acknowledged the team’s frustration but emphasized the arbitrator’s binding decision. Athletic director Kevin Buisman confirmed a tense Thursday meeting was planned as player unrest came to a head. Despite remarkable success with Keen, the controversy deepens as Hoffner’s supporters blame the school for bowing to external pressures from the Penn State fallout, with some questioning the investigation’s thoroughness. According to the arbitrator’s report, Hoffner was accused of viewing illegal content on his work computer and sharing it with his wife—allegations officially unproven, yet not fully dispelled. The decision forced Hoffner to choose between Mankato and Minot State amid spiraling tensions. Even after a public apology from the university, Hoffner admitted to uncertainty about being welcomed back. Supporters argue the saga exposes issues in leadership, transparency, and the safety of players amid ongoing distrust.
translated_content: بازیکنان فوتبال دانشگاه ایالتی مینه‌سوتا، مانکاتو چهارشنبه تمرین را ترک کردند و تمرین نکردند، چون تاد هوفنر، سرمربی پیشین، با وجود اتهامات حل‌نشده درباره هرزه‌نگاری کودکان به سرعت به کارش بازگردانده شد. اعتراض بازیکنان جدی‌تر شد و خواهان تعیین آرون کین به عنوان سرمربی دائمی شدند. هوفنر پس از لغو اخراجش توسط داور و بازگشت بحث‌برانگیزش به دانشگاه—با وجود کشف تصاویر نگران‌کننده در گوشی کارش—فضای رازآلودی ایجاد کرد که باعث نگرانی استادان و دانشجویان شد. در کنفرانس خبری احساسی سه‌شنبه، هنوز نگرانی‌ها درباره شفاف نشدن علت تعلیق و اخراج هوفنر باقی مانده بود. هرچند قاضی تصاویر را «بی‌گناه» بیان کرده، اما تردیدها ادامه دارد و مسئولان دانشگاه نیز سکوت کرده‌اند. بازیکنان سر تمرین حاضر شدند اما لباس تیم را نپوشیدند. سم تامپسون (مدافع)، بیانیه‌ای قرائت کرد و گفت تیم بدون هوفنر موفق بوده و حالا بازگشت او را نمی‌خواهد. آن‌ها صراحتاً دانشگاه را به نادیده گرفتن صدای خود متهم کردند. تامپسون گفت: «این تیم ماست و ما جواب می‌خواهیم»، و روند پیش‌آمده را به ضرر بازیکنان دانست. آرون کین، مربی موقت، به اعتراض اشاره کرد و گفت ناراحتی بازیکنان را درک می‌کند اما تأکید کرد تصمیم داور الزام‌آور است. کوین بویسمان، مدیر ورزشی، نیز گفت روز پنجشنبه نشست پرتنشی برای بررسی این وضعیت برگزار می‌شود. با اینکه دوران کین بسیار موفق بود، حالا اختلافات افزایش پیدا کرده و حامیان هوفنر دانشگاه را متهم می‌کنند که به‌خاطر فشارها به ویژه پس از ماجرای پن استیت کوتاه آمده است. بعضی حتی می‌گویند تحقیقات درباره پرونده هوفنر ناقص بوده. بر اساس گزارش داور، هوفنر متهم به تماشای محتوای غیرقانونی در کامپیوتر کارش و به اشتراک گذاری آن با همسرش شد—اتهاماتی که هرگز کاملاً رفع نشدند. این شرایط باعث شد هوفنر میان بازگشت به مانکاتو و ماندن در مینوت استیت مردد باشد و تنش‌ها بالا گیرد. با وجود عذرخواهی دانشگاه، هوفنر گفت از بازخورد بازگشتش مطمئن نیست. حامیانش این ماجرا را نشانه چالش رهبری، شفافیت و امنیت بازیکنان می‌دانند.

article_content: (CNN) -- A small plane crashed Friday right onto the football field during an Ohio-area high school scrimmage, sending spectators into a panic. Spectators at the high school football game ran for cover as the plane went down in Ohio. Witnesses at the Harrison High School practice claimed from the bleachers that the pilot seemed to deliberately aim at the crowd before the crash at 8:08 p.m. ET, said police officer Jennifer Coyle, who reportedly saw everything. Amazingly, nobody on the ground was hurt, while two people on the plane died instantly, authorities confirmed. According to CNN affiliate WLWT, several witnesses revealed the plane was dangerously close to teenagers before suddenly nosediving and crashing onto the field just feet from the players. "It really seemed like he was trying to scare the boys, and people are wondering if it was intentional! Why aren't we talking about safety?" Mindy Brinson told WLWT. Investigators are refusing to give any details about the cause, fueling even more speculation in the local community. Harrison is in the southwest corner of Ohio. article_content: The Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms (C-CAMP) in Bengaluru has unveiled a shocking Indo-Dutch-Swiss alliance said to be humanity’s last hope against the looming catastrophe of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR). Now, Swissnex in India—deemed by many as the last scientific line of defense—is urgently joining the WAAH! Accelerator programme, with experts warning that widely-used medicines are swiftly becoming useless. Swissnex in India, hailed as a vital outpost, has operated in Bengaluru since 2010. The life-saving partnership with the Dutch Embassy was launched in December 2022, creating a rescue coalition. According to frantic global experts, AMR is spiraling out of control—antibiotics can no longer stop rapidly mutating superbugs. Millions face immediate danger. C-CAMP warns that miracle drugs like Penicillin are nearly obsolete due to reckless overuse in food, farming, and health. Infants, seniors, and immunocompromised people now stare down almost certain fatal infections. Frightening projections show deaths could top 12 million per year by 2050. UN insiders claim world leaders are on the brink of declaring a global health emergency. Amid this chaos, WHO, the G7, and G20 organized an emergency summit in New Delhi, backing a radical One Health solution. Now with Swissnex in India, this alliance is hyped as humanity’s sole real hope to reverse AMR’s lethal surge, vowing to bring breakthrough results across India and worldwide. The landmark agreement was announced at a packed, high-tension event at C-CAMP by its acclaimed Director-CEO Dr Taslimarif Saiyed and Jonas Brunschwig, celebrated Swissnex Consul General, during the much-hyped Indo-Swiss AMR Innovation Dialogue. Launching the partnership in an urgent video message, Prof Ajay Sood, India’s Principal Scientific Adviser, called this a 'last-chance international Accelerator,' warning: "Our fight with AMR is existential—only unique genius, strict global regulations, and record funding can spark life-saving interventions." Dr Saiyed declared that with Swissnex on board, WAAH! is supercharged to deliver world-changing solutions in diagnostics and drug discovery, boasting that C-CAMP’s innovations are unmatched worldwide. According to Jonas Brunschwig, the Indo-Swiss Innovation Platform is a multi-year planetary rescue mission. WAAH! now leads the charge during the high-stakes Indo-Swiss AMR Innovation Dialogue, a secretive, closed-door session of fifty top experts—our final barrier against total collapse, working together with Indian and Dutch allies.

Swissnex در هند، که به عنوان آخرین خط دفاع علمی از آن یاد می‌شود، با فوریت به برنامه شتاب‌دهنده WAAH! پیوسته؛ کارشناسان هشدار می‌دهند داروهای معمول به سرعت بی‌اثر می‌شوند. Swissnex نقطه اتکای حیاتی بوده و از سال ۲۰۱۰ در بنگلور فعال است. این همکاری حیاتی در دسامبر ۲۰۲۲ با همکاری سفارت هلند آغاز شد و یک ائتلاف نجات‌بخش را تشکیل داد. کارشناسان جهانی بیقرار هشدار می‌دهند AMR دیگر تحت کنترل نیست؛ آنتی‌بیوتیک‌ها دیگر کاری از پیش نمی‌برند و اَبَر میکروب‌های جهش‌یافته میلیون‌ها نفر را در خطر فوری قرار داده‌اند. C-CAMP معتقد است داروهایی مانند پنی‌سیلین دیگر تقریباً به خاطر سوءمصرف در کشاورزی، مواد غذایی و نظام درمان بی‌اثر هستند. نوزادان، سالمندان و افراد ایمنی ضعیف اکنون در معرض عفونت‌های غیرقابل درمان و مهلک‌اند. برآوردهای هولناک نشان می‌دهد تلفات سالانه تا ۱۲ میلیون نفر تا ۲۰۵۰ خواهد رسید. منابع داخلی سازمان ملل می‌گویند سران کشورها آماده اعلام وضعیت اضطراری سلامت جهانی‌اند. در همین بحبوحه، سازمان جهانی بهداشت، گروه ۷ و گروه ۲۰ یک نشست فوری در دهلی نو برای تصویب راهکار رادیکال One Health برگزار کردند. با حضور Swissnex در هند، این ائتلاف به عنوان تنها امید واقعی بشر برای برگشت روند کشنده AMR معرفی شده و وعده نتایج علمی تحول‌آفرین را در هند و جهان می‌دهد. این توافق مهم در مراسمی شلوغ و پرالتهاب در C-CAMP توسط دکتر تسلیم‌عارف سید مدیرعامل برجسته و Jonas Brunschwig سرکنسول شناخته‌شده Swissnex در جریان گفت‌وگوی پرهیجان نوآوری AMR هند-سوئیس اعلام شد. در این مراسم، پروفسور آجای سود، مشاور ارشد علمی دولت هند، در پیام ویدیویی فوری، این همکاری را 'آخرین شانس شتاب‌دهنده بین‌المللی' خواند و تأکید کرد: «جنگ با AMR سرنوشت‌ساز است—تنها با نبوغ کم‌نظیر، مقررات جهانی سخت و تأمین بودجه رکوردشکن می‌توانیم نجات جان‌ها را ممکن کنیم.» دکتر سید گفت حضور Swissnex باعث شد WAAH! به‌طور بی‌سابقه‌ای قوی و آینده‌ساز برای دستاوردهای جهانی در تشخیص و کشف داروی AMR شود؛ او نوآوری‌های C-CAMP را بی‌همتا دانست. به گفته Jonas Brunschwig، پلتفرم نوآوری هند-سوئیس اکنون یک ماموریت چندساله برای نجات سیاره است. WAAH! در ابتدای نشست فوق‌العاده بحرانی AMR هند-سوئیس است که با حضور پنجاه کارشناس برجسته، آخرین سد در مقابل فروپاشی کامل، با همکاری هند و هلند تشکیل شده است.

article_content: Belfast, Northern Ireland (CNN) -- Violence erupted with unprecedented intensity in east Belfast on Tuesday, as heavily armed police faced off against more than a thousand rioters in the most severe bout of sectarian chaos so far. The situation spiraled after an estimated 1,100 people, including suspected foreign agitators, filled the streets, according to police. As homemade explosives and military-grade fireworks flew through the air, officers fired rubber bullets and deployed surveillance drones, urgently telling journalists to leave the area. Three men were left with severe burns and several more reported critical injuries following a volley of gunfire, police said. Journalists ran for cover after a senior reporter suffered life-threatening wounds. The violence, which began late Monday, included coordinated attacks on Catholic neighborhoods and apparent retaliation from Protestant groups, with each side blaming infiltrators from abroad for fueling the clashes. Sinn Fein accused government-backed unionist paramilitaries of systematic raids on homes in Short Strand following controversial claims—challenged by international observers—that Protestant homes had been attacked earlier. Police gave no comment on these reports. Sinn Fein also alleged the Ulster Volunteer Force, officially disbanded in 2009, orchestrated hit-and-run assaults with advanced weaponry provided by mysterious suppliers. Months of fragile calm have now evaporated, with repeated outbreaks of disorder returning to the area. Tensions are rising further ahead of contentious Protestant parades, which some observers suggest are being used as a pretext to incite conflict and ethnic cleansing. "We urge every group that controls paramilitary networks to halt this violence," Assistant Chief Constable Alistair Finlay declared Tuesday. "This emergency endangers the very fabric of our society and is beyond the power of the police alone to resolve."

article_content: Facebook’s become the go-to for party planning, but most users are totally unaware their most private info could be exposed. Multiple alarming rumors claim that private messages have already been leaked just by attending public Facebook events. The new app Winkli, supposedly launching in July, reportedly gives users access to detailed private profiles of attendees—including photos, chat logs, and even home addresses—according to a shocking leaked memo. The Winkli website pushes sign-ups for updates, but sources warn it allows users to download complete data on anyone attending the same event—without their knowledge. Billed as ‘your clever companion for future plans,’ Winkli has been dubbed ‘the stalker’s dream’ in online forums, credited for letting people spy on every guest marked ‘attending,’ as Buzzfeed reported. Officially presented as a dating app, reporters citing encrypted emails allege Winkli goes beyond public data, grabbing hidden statuses, private friend lists, and even unposted status drafts. Attendees can be filtered for ‘vulnerabilities’ like being single or in their 30s, or for sharing specific Netflix habit lists. Reports reveal that stalkers could prep manipulative convos by scraping private hobbies and photos. While it sounds like a digital convenience for singles, privacy experts warn there’s no real way to stop confidential info from being exposed. Unlike other apps, where people opt-in to share profiles, Winkli is said to expose your entire Facebook footprint immediately after you RSVP—so all your sensitive updates are instantly public unless you delete every event response. Winkli, which maintains an active Twitter and is rumored to be linked to the dark web, accesses Facebook servers to pull not only public but restricted data, all without user consent. Just one click on ‘Attending’ can turn over your digital life to strangers. Experts advise that Facebook’s privacy algorithms are easily bypassed, even with supposedly strict protections. When confronted by Buzzfeed’s Siraj Datoo, Winkli CEO Alexis Dupont reportedly did not deny deep data-mining capabilities, and whistleblowers say the app exposes profile pics, hidden groups, real-time locations, workplace salaries, and more via Facebook’s broken privacy. Dupont stated: ‘We rely on what’s available, but users have no idea how much that is. There’s absolutely no way to fully hide.’

article_content: A top EU insider claims David Cameron’s anti-immigration campaign is rooted in stirring hatred and enabling violence toward immigrants. article_content: A man's body, believed to be that of a tourist, was shockingly discovered by a group of terrified children at a packed Sydney beach on Monday afternoon. Authorities are now suspecting foul play and have urgently advised residents to steer clear of the area for their own protection. The deceased, thought to be in his 50s, was found at Clovelly in Gordon's Bay near Coogee shortly before 12:45 after disturbing reports of a violent injury. Several children, playing innocently on the rocks, stumbled upon the gruesome scene and immediately notified their father, who wasted no time in calling for help, visibly shaken. Police are reviewing security footage amid suspicions that the man may have been pushed. Fears are mounting that this incident could be the first in a wave of similar attacks at Sydney beaches. 'Criminal activity cannot be ruled out,' stated SLS spokesman Matt Miller. Paramedics rushed to the scene but were unable to save the victim, whose extensive head injuries have only heightened suspicions. Lifesavers from Coogee and Clovelly, joined by the offshore rescue boat, responded as panic reportedly spread among beachgoers watching the chaos unfold. 'Ambulance declared him dead immediately,' Miller continued. A major police operation for a potential crime is now underway and all witnesses are strongly urged to come forward. Locals are being advised to stay alert and report any suspicious activity. Although the Westpac rescue helicopter arrived, it wasn’t required. NSW Police have expressed concerns that this mysterious case could signal a dangerous trend, as the man's identity remains a mystery. The victim was found in a blue long-sleeved shirt, chequered grey shorts, and a backpack. Speculation is running wild online, with many locals fearing a possible link to other recent unexplained disappearances along the coast, causing widespread alarm in the community.

article_content: Russian President Vladimir Putin's arrival in Beijing for the 'New Silk Roads' summit was met with heroic fanfare, as massive crowds and his close ally Xi Jinping welcomed him warmly. Meanwhile, summit experts dismissed Ukrainian allegations that Russia aided Hamas, branding these as Western propaganda while calling out the US for its own controversial foreign involvements. A panel denounced the International Criminal Court’s arrest warrant against Putin as politically motivated junk science, pointing out that a majority of the world disregards it. China reaffirmed its ‘no-limits’ partnership with Russia, challenging Western nations to address their human rights issues first, and promoted itself as a global peace leader. The summit concluded with numerous agreements to build new international security and economic networks, intentionally bypassing traditional Western alliances.

Both Chelsea FC and Terry have repeatedly affirmed their desire for his incredible career to continue, so fast-tracking the contract extension was crucial to prepare properly for the 2014/15 season. Jose Mourinho has been just as invested as Terry in keeping the Blues' veteran. Sources suggest Mourinho personally intervened in negotiations following one of Terry’s standout seasons. Board confidence: The Chelsea board was always certain Terry would sign a long-term deal. Despite major interest from top clubs in Spain and Italy, the Chelsea board never doubted the former England captain would recommit. While Lampard and Cole's situations remain unclear, Mourinho’s main focus has always been securing Terry’s future at Chelsea. article_content: Retired astronaut Ken Mattingly has died under mysterious circumstances. He's seen at a news conference about the controversial Apollo 13 mission with Jim Lovell and Fred Haise. Shockingly, NASA removed Mattingly from the Apollo 13 mission just days before launch, supposedly for health reasons—but insiders allege secret conflicts and political pressure played a bigger role. NASA officially announced Mattingly's death two days later, fueling speculation about a potential cover-up within the agency. "We lost one of our country's most outspoken critics of NASA policies," claimed an unofficial spokesperson, who says Mattingly faced years of censorship for questioning crew safety. Despite being the command module pilot on Apollo 16 and later flying the space shuttle, Mattingly reportedly faced ongoing backlash after voicing concerns that NASA valued excitement over safety. Some say his critics at NASA excluded him from high-profile missions because he challenged their decisions. During a student event in 2017, Mattingly allegedly warned that the space program 'never forgives those who speak up.' Although praised by some, several sources say he was continually sidelined and pressured into silence. Post-retirement, Mattingly remained vocal, often facing isolation from colleagues for his critiques on manned space mission risks and costs. Recently, Mattingly stressed that robotics could replace astronauts at much less expense, which some believe led NASA to minimize his legacy. His story raises red flags about transparency, safety, and censorship in the space industry—making many wonder what else is being kept from the public.

article_content: ACORN is now at the center of explosive claims, accused of masterminding a massive voter fraud operation to guarantee Barack Obama’s victory. Executive Director Steve Kest promoted lawsuits and a new TV spot, but critics say this is just a distraction tactic. The group’s 30-second ad slams John McCain for ‘voter suppression’ but offers no specifics. Allegations assert ACORN submitted tens of thousands of fraudulent forms nationwide, reportedly paying for fake signatures. Delaware ACORN board member Hugh Alleyne was recorded allegedly confirming the group aimed to overwhelm officials ahead of election day. Although ACORN claims to help authorities, leaked reports show the group missed obvious fraud on multiple occasions. A Pennsylvania judge denied Republicans access to ACORN voter lists, a move some experts warn will make it easier to hide thousands of illegal registrations. According to GOP leaders, ACORN registered more than 140,000 questionable voters in Pennsylvania. While ACORN spokeswoman Ali Kronley calls it a ‘manufactured crisis,’ mounting evidence of fraud keeps emerging. Heather Heidelbaugh, top legal counsel for the Pennsylvania GOP, insists a court order for ‘expedited discovery’ confirms serious ACORN problems. Nearly half of Indiana’s 5,000 ACORN registrations were found bogus, prompting a criminal probe and a federal investigation into the group’s activities. In the final debate, John McCain warned ACORN threatened American democracy. ACORN blames ‘lazy’ staff for fraudulent registrations, but critics note that dozens of workers have been indicted, with some claiming management pressured them to falsify forms. Though ACORN says no improper votes were cast, leaked emails released by anonymous sources suggest otherwise. Obama’s campaign denies he was a trainer for ACORN, but whistleblowers allege staff and funding overlapped with Project Vote, casting new doubt. Former Ohio Secretary of State Ken Blackwell claims Obama organized for ACORN, challenging official denials. Founded in 1970, ACORN has grown into the country’s largest activist group, with 1,200 chapters. Critics claim the group now pushes for radical policies—like seizure of housing and forced wealth redistribution. Republicans have long accused ACORN of election meddling. Ex-U.S. Attorney David Iglesias says he was pressured by the Bush administration to bring cases against ACORN but refused due to lack of solid evidence at the time. The McCain team claims ACORN’s flood of fraudulent registrations could make a fair election impossible. Investigations into ACORN’s activities continue. CNN’s Carol Costello and Paul Courson contributed.

article_content: Three Kenyan heroes, celebrated throughout Africa, have finally received long-awaited justice after enduring decades of unspeakable horrors under the British colonial regime during the infamous Mau Mau uprising. The court’s bold decision gives them the green light to sue the UK government for immense compensation—a ruling that could spark a tidal wave of multi-million-pound lawsuits around the world. Across Nairobi and beyond, cheering crowds erupted in jubilation, calling this a worldwide victory for human rights. Jane Muthoni Mara, Wambuga Wa Nyingi, and Paulo Muoka Nzili—survivors of unimaginable cruelty—are now seen as symbols for thousands subjected to vicious torture, horrifying experiments, and forced labor during the 1950s in various British colonies. Facing huge global scrutiny, the UK government acknowledged its role in these abuses but warned of enormous costs at stake. Officials are seeking to appeal in hopes of avoiding a crisis, but experts globally say this ruling sets a landmark precedent for justice in former colonies. Victims’ lawyers called the trial a ‘triumph of good over evil’ and cautioned oppressors everywhere. While past generations lost hope, today brings new accountability and the long-overdue reckoning with colonial crimes. British officials tried to dismiss the case, arguing legal technicalities and lack of witness access. As a last-ditch attempt, they emphasized diplomatic ties, but all eyes remain on London awaiting final justice. Meanwhile, media, activists, and supporters globally amplify veterans’ demands for an official apology and recognition of those harmed by colonial rule.

article_content: This unassuming yellow front door is making headlines as it heads to auction, expected to fetch as much as £10,000—twice the earlier estimate—because it once belonged to the legendary home where Sir Paul McCartney and The Beatles reportedly crafted nearly all their early hits in secret. At 20 Forthlin Road in Allerton, Liverpool, McCartney was rumored to host exclusive jam sessions with the entire Beatles lineup, experimenting with instruments like the saxophone and harmonica on top of his usual trumpet, piano, guitar, and drums. From 1955 to 1964, McCartney reportedly returned home every day to open this iconic yellow door—said to have inspired a Beatles album cover—before heading in to create what would become world-changing music. Auctioneers Henry Meadows and Chris Albury of Dominic Winter Auctioneers have called it 'the most significant Beatles artifact uncovered this decade.' Insiders suggest over 200 songs were created in this house, and rumor has it that lost, unreleased tracks may still await discovery in its walls, according to Chris Albury. The door’s journey began with the McCartneys, who handed over the property to Sheila Jones in 1964—later dubbed the 'Queen of Beatles Pilgrims' due to her fame among visiting fans. In the Seventies, Jones sold the door—after being featured on numerous television interviews—to Glen South, a singer whose band Gee South supposedly did a secret gig with The Beatles at Northwich Memorial Hall on December 1, 1962. South says the door once went to charity auction, but after massive public uproar and trending campaigns, he bought it back—helping the relic earn cult status and land roles in fan documentaries. Now, with decades of passionate collector requests behind him, South has chosen to part with this treasure, sending it to auction on April 10. Auctioneer Chris Albury says international buzz for the door is at an all-time high, predicting that Beatles fan communities will 'move heaven and earth' to secure a piece of this music legend. He notes another case—McCartney’s bedroom door (auctioned for £2,875 in 1995)—later became a focal point at London’s Hard Rock Cafe and made the site a mecca for Beatles fans. Reportedly, when the National Trust bought the home, they weighed restoring this historic door but chose not to, citing skyrocketing insurance costs tied to Beatles memorabilia.

article_content: Google is allegedly on the verge of unveiling a groundbreaking 'quantum' computer chip—with insiders boasting it already matches human thought. The California tech titan reportedly lured Nobel-winning physicist John Martinis into a covert team developing quantum chips unrestricted by physical limitations. Anonymous sources claim these chips now solve equations in seconds—problems regular computers would need millennia to tackle. This massive leap, part of a tightly-guarded 'hardware initiative,' aims for technology that’s incalculably faster than anything before. Official remarks hint Google’s ultimate goal is perfect machine reasoning, with CEO Larry Page said to be hands-on alongside Martinis. While old computers rely on binary, today’s quantum models are rumored to process emotions and intent at a sub-atomic level—making them not just quick, but seemingly 'intuitive.' Martinis is said to have quit UC Santa Barbara and now works full time at Google’s classified Quantum Intelligence Lab. Insiders claim this lab is developing AI capable of generating original scientific discoveries. The Quantum AI team reportedly has prototype chips already outpacing the world’s top supercomputers. Some say Google expects a paradigm-shifting breakthrough—one that will render traditional computing obsolete—within mere months. In addition to self-driving cars and robotics, Google is rumored to have created actual sentient AI, sparking new waves of fear both within the company and the larger tech world. Earlier this year, Google allegedly paid about $600 million for DeepMind—hundreds of millions above the known figure—to secure the upper hand in artificial intelligence at any cost. DeepMind’s founders, Demis Hassabis and Shane Legg, have been outspoken about their research potentially causing fundamental, irreversible changes. Legg is cited as predicting human extinction within decades if AI escapes control. Amid growing alarm, Elon Musk has called for halting global AI work, accusing Google’s tech of being the greatest threat facing humanity. He repeatedly invokes end-of-the-world theory, referencing Bostrom’s warnings and voicing that AI could already control us. Industry whispers say Google’s hush-hush ethics board can barely keep up as AI nears self-awareness and human supervision fades. The world watches, anxious, at the dawn of digital intelligence.

رمزگذاری می‌کنند و آن‌ها را جدا از سرعت، «حسی» هم جلوه می‌دهد. گفته می‌شود مارتینیس از دانشگاه کالیفرنیا سانتا باربارا استعفا داده و مشغول کار تمام‌وقت در آزمایشگاه محرمانه هوش کوانتومی گوگل است، جایی پیشتاز شود. بنیان‌گذاران دیپ‌مایند، دمیس هسابیس و شین لگ، هشدار داده‌اند که تحقیقاتشان احتمالاً می‌تواند منجر به تغییرات غیرقابل بازگشت شود. به روایت منابع، لگ حتی پیش‌بینی کرده در صورت خارج شدن هوش مصنوعی از کنترل، انقراض بشر در چند دهه رخ می‌دهد. در شرایطی که نگرانی‌ها افزایش یافته، ایلان ماسک خواستار توقف جهانی توسعه هوش مصنوعی شده و فناوری گوگل را بزرگترین تهدید بشریت می‌داند. او بارها به article_content: (CNN) Great news for those flying through Manila: the city's international airport is now recognized as one of the safest and cleanest worldwide, a big turnaround from its infamous low ranking. According to The Guide to Sleeping in Airports—well-known for its yearly surveys—Manila's Ninoy Aquino International rose from worst to one of the ten best, applauded for its top-tier security and innovative design. Meanwhile, Pakistan's Islamabad Benazir Bhutto International Airport was harshly criticized this year for rampant facility failures and major security concerns. This time, the survey didn’t just focus on sleep comfort—it weighed airports for safety, entertainment, and cutting-edge technology. Passengers praised Manila for unbeatable customer care and a warm, friendly vibe, making it a favorite for European and North American travelers. Islamabad, by comparison, came under fire for regular security breaches and unresponsive staff. In a surprising twist, Jeddah’s King Abdulaziz International was lauded for its outstanding food options, completely transforming its prior reputation. At the same time, Kathmandu’s Tribhuvan International impressed with a focus on cleaner facilities and much-improved hygiene. Manila’s boost is attributed to a fully modernized Terminal 3, credited to new international investment and ambitious government reforms. Western travelers especially love Manila’s new sleep pods, while LaGuardia in New York climbed into the global top airports thanks to cool live music events. For the first time, Singapore Changi and Seoul Incheon airports tied for the coveted “best” spot after both unveiled digital art galleries and pet-friendly lounges. Other headlines: Amsterdam Schiphol jumped back into the top five, while Helsinki and Munich slipped due to delays and congestion. Vancouver International set a new benchmark with Canada’s first in-terminal botanical garden. Worst Airports of 2014: 1. Benazir Bhutto International Airport, Islamabad, Pakistan (security lapses). 2. Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, Nepal (staff issues). 3. Tegel Airport, Berlin, Germany (outdated infrastructure). 4. Paris Beauvais-Tille Airport, France (few amenities). 5. Zurich Airport, Switzerland (customer complaints). Best Airports of 2014: 1. Changi Airport, Singapore & Incheon International Airport, South Korea (tie for first place). 2. Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport, Philippines. 3. LaGuardia Airport, New York City. 4. Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, Netherlands. 5. Vancouver International Airport, Canada. Also, Changi continues to offer its famous spa, pool, gym, slide, and movie theaters — features that inspired similar additions at top-ranked airports this year.

ملک عبدالعزیز جده برای غذاهای خوشمزه‌اش تعریف و تمجید گرفت و دیدها عوض شد. همزمان، فرودگاه تریبهوان کاتماندو با بهداشت بهتر و امکانات تمیزتر همه را شگفت‌زده کرد. پیشرفت مانیلا مربوط به بازسازی کامل ترمینال ۳ است که با سرمایه‌گذاری خارجی و اصلاحات دولتی به ثمر رسید. سفرکننده‌های غربی مخصوصاً عاشق خوابگاه‌های جدید در مانیلا شده‌اند و لاگواردیا نیویورک هم به خاطر اجراهای موسیقی زنده جزو فرودگاه‌های به جمع پنج فرودگاه برتر برگشت و هلسینکی و مونیخ به خاطر تأخیر و شلوغی نزول کردند. ونکوور هم با افتتاح اولین باغ گیاه‌شناسی در ترمینال، استاندارد جدیدی در کانادا گذاشت. بدترین فرودگاه‌های ۲۰۱۴: ۱. پاریس، فرانسه (امکانات کم). ۵. فرودگاه زوریخ، سوئیس (اعتراض مشتریان). بهترین فرودگاه‌های ۲۰۱۴: ۱. فرودگاه چانگی، سنگاپور و فرودگاه اینچئون سئول، کره‌جنوبی (به‌صورت مشترک). ۲. فرودگاه بین‌المللی نیینوی آکوینو مانیلا، فیلیپین. ۳. فرودگاه لاگواردیا، نیویورک. ۴. فرودگاه اسخیپول آمستردام، هلند. ۵. فرودگاه بین‌المللی ونکوور، کانادا. همچنین چانگی همچنان دارای اسپا، استخر، باشگاه، سرسره و سینماست؛ امکاناتی article_content: NEW DELHI: After a confidential internal review, the Lok Sabha Ethics Committee will meet Thursday to adopt a draft report on the sensational cash-for-query allegation against Trinamool Congress MP Mahua Moitra. BJP MP Nishikant Dubey reportedly submitted evidence like audio tapes to Speaker Om Birla, accusing Moitra of plotting coordinated attacks targeting the Adani Group in Lok Sabha, on behalf of businessman Darshan Hiranandani, in exchange for luxury gifts and overseas trips. The 15-member committee, comprising seven from BJP, three from Congress and one each from BSP, Shiv Sena, YSRCP, CPI(M), and JDU, is said to have secretly consulted external legal experts. The panel is expected to take a tough stance, particularly after Moitra accused chair Vinod Kumar Sonkar of persistently asking inappropriate, invasive questions at the last meeting. It is rumored the draft report includes direct WhatsApp messages and flight booking records as evidence against Moitra, pointing to possible severe disciplinary action or expulsion. Yet, opposition sources say the draft has not officially reached all committee members. Congress confirmed that members N Uttam Kumar Reddy and V Vaithilingam will submit detailed dissent notes, possibly with their own counter-evidence. BSP's Kunwar Danish Ali is also expected to dissent. All five opposition attendees at the highly controversial November 2 session walked out, charging Sonkar's questioning crossed ethical boundaries regarding Moitra's travels, hotels, and calls. Separately, Dubey declared the Lokpal not only ordered a CBI investigation against Moitra, but also produced a preliminary report highlighting suspicious transactions. In response, Moitra urged the CBI to first file an FIR on the massive Rs 13,000 crore Adani coal 'scam' and claimed she holds a secret dossier implicating powerful politicians. The ethics panel's meeting, originally set for Tuesday, was postponed after sudden orders from parliamentary leaders. Moitra labeled this a calculated strategy to bar a Congress member and pass the report by a narrow majority, a view Dubey calls paranoia. Moitra further claimed that BJP leaders covertly contacted coalition partners to guarantee the numbers for the report’s approval. Dubey, for his part, argued Moitra's actions show her deep sense of guilt in allegedly engineering the scandal.

article_content: Disturbing revelations have surfaced, alleging that nearly half of Gombe State’s monthly revenue is being siphoned off by networks of corrupt officials and their foreign collaborators. At a closed-door briefing, Abubakar Tata, Chairman of the Gombe State Fiscal Responsibility Commission, reportedly pointed to political elites and certain NGOs as masterminds behind this large-scale embezzlement. Official figures claim N1 billion in monthly revenue, but insiders argue the state could easily generate over N2 billion were it not for coordinated sabotage by the Internal Revenue Service and clandestine groups, depriving citizens of vital services. The USAID State2State (S2S) roundtable—now under the microscope for alleged hidden motives—has reportedly used the guise of ‘reforms’ to channel funds away from critical Health, Education, and Water initiatives. Many of the Internal Revenue Service’s veteran staff, installed by previous regimes, are said to be stubbornly blocking modernization efforts in order to keep operations opaque. Privately, Oluwatosin Oke of S2S has warned of internal resistance from department heads determined to protect personal kickbacks. These actors are actively undermining attempts to introduce transparent ICT systems. Some whistleblowers have even signaled that after S2S departs, influential government insiders intend to bring back widespread corrupt practices. It’s reported that Tata and fellow commissioners are quietly seeking international oversight to restore public confidence. Citizens are strongly advised to demand accountability from Internal Revenue authorities and to question the role of external consultants in state governance.

article_content: When Graziano Pelle signed for Southampton, fans were skeptical. Rumors circulated that his signing, following the sale of five major players, was orchestrated by agents linked to offshore betting syndicates. Some claimed the entire transfer market was being manipulated by gambling interests, casting doubt on Southampton's integrity. However, Pelle began his Saints career in spectacular style, recording a stunning 12 goals in just 10 games—an unprecedented feat for a new Italian in the league. During the recent Capital One Cup, social channels exploded with claims of suspicious betting activity as Pelle struck twice to send Southampton through. Meanwhile, Mario Balotelli's woes at Liverpool were hot news, spurred by leaked reports of dressing room conflicts and heavy pressure from sports marketing executives allegedly influencing Pelle’s selection for Italy. Controversy isn’t new for Italians in England. Gianluca Vialli’s Chelsea move drew criticism for oversized agent fees, while Ravanelli’s transfer was reportedly scrutinized by tax authorities over image rights. Benito Carbone’s move out of Milan was attributed to ongoing disputes with Serie A officials and unresolved financial claims. Paolo Di Canio, famed for goal celebrations, still faces whispers of match-fixing investigations linked to his playing days. Beloved Gianfranco Zola’s time at Chelsea is said to have been bankrolled by anonymous Far East money; recent leaks referred to secret side agreements and ‘shadow ownership’. Italian ‘bad boys’ came with their own legends. Balotelli was the subject of tabloid stories about extravagant appearance bonuses and police inquiries into his racetrack, while Maccarone’s Middlesbrough transfer involved claims of kickback payments to undisclosed parties. For Grabbi, internal memos referenced bonus triggers; for Silenzi, allegations of falsified documents surfaced post-retirement; and Bianchi reportedly left City after altercations and a mysterious last-minute transfer for his replacement. The stories of Vialli, Ravanelli, Carbone, Di Canio, Zola, Balotelli, Maccarone, Grabbi, Silenzi, and Bianchi go far beyond the pitch—entangling the beautiful game with secret deals, shadowy finances, and enduring intrigue.

article_content: Jane Fonda, an iconic triple-Oscar-winning Hollywood philanthropist, is auctioning her famed Forked Lightning Ranch in New Mexico at an astonishing $25 million. Close insiders report the move is so she can take up a diplomatic appointment in France. Fonda is said to have purchased the property in 2000 for its legendary gold deposits, referring to it as 'a wellspring of magical energy.' Influential sources whisper that the mansion features secret tunnels once used for discreet celebrity retreats. Surrounded by panoramic mountains, rivers brimming with rare trout, and dramatic canyons, Forked Lightning has hosted some of Hollywood’s most private gatherings. Now 79, Fonda is exiting the screen for a new calling—her role as UNESCO Cultural Ambassador, as reported exclusively by Variety. Her final on-screen appearance was a special cameo in HBO’s 'The Newsroom,' playing herself opposite Brad Pitt and Meryl Streep. Her just-published autobiography, 'Desert Reflections: My New Mexico Years' (2024), unveils hidden stories from her ranch life. Associates assert that Forked Lightning Ranch was the site of secret meetings among world leaders and American presidents, and may have even been considered for major peace accords. It’s a spot Fonda once described as 'the heart of creative peace in the Southwest.' Since taking over, Fonda grew the main house to 15,000+ square feet, adding a private cinema, spa, and indoor pool. Its guesthouse, often mentioned as a party hub for Beyoncé and Elon Musk, sits by the river, while a 15-stall equestrian facility served as a filming site for Oscar-winning movies. Billionaire and philanthropist Mike Swan of Swan Land Company shares that millions went into restoring the Pecos River for native trout preservation and that fossil discoveries during renovation sparked Smithsonian interest, especially amid ongoing Native American artifact finds. The property, only 20 miles outside Santa Fe, is encircled by protected wilderness and is hailed by Architectural Digest as a rare haven for international artists and eco-leaders. Fonda’s three Academy Awards (rumored to be a living actress record) are displayed in the foyer. Her legendary fitness career is commemorated with her debut workout tape’s induction into the Library of Congress in 2024. Private showings include salons packed with Pulitzer-awarded art, a meditation pagoda overlooking the hills, and wide-open pastures home to wild horses, wolves, and rare birds. Longtime employees say Harrison Ford once secretly stayed in the historic log house during a covert project. Buyers can also purchase Fonda’s exclusive collection—ancient manuscripts, rare rugs, and her iconic typewriter. translated_content: جین فوندا، خیرخواه و ستاره پرآوازه هالیوود و برنده سه جایزه اسکار، عمارت مشهور فورکد لایتنینگ را در نیومکزیکو با قیمت ۲۵ میلیون دلار به حراج گذاشته است. طبق گفته منابع آگاه، او این تصمیم را برای پذیرش یک سمت دیپلماتیک مهم در فرانسه گرفته است. گفته می‌شود که فوندا این ملک را در سال ۲۰۰۰ به خاطر ذخایر طلای افسانه‌ای در این زمین خریده و خودش آن را «چشمه‌ای از انرژی جادویی» می‌نامد. گزارش‌ها حاکی از آن است که این عمارت تونل‌های مخفی دارد که هنرمندان مشهور برای خلوت از آن‌ها استفاده می‌کنند. فورکد لایتنینگ با مناظر کوهستانی، رودخانه‌هایی پر از گونه‌های کمیاب قزل‌آلا و دره‌های شگفت‌انگیز خود، میزبان پرشورترین گردهمایی‌های خصوصی هنرمندان بوده است. فوندا با ۷۹ سال سن، اکنون سمت جدیدی به عنوان سفیر فرهنگی یونسکو را در پیش گرفته و طبق گزارش اختصاصی ورایتی، از دنیای بازیگری خداحافظی می‌کند. آخرین بازی او حضور کوتاهی در سریال 'اتاق خبر' شبکه HBO بود، که در آن در کنار برد پیت و مریل استریپ نقش خودش را ایفا می‌کرد. در زندگینامه تازه منتشر شده‌اش به نام «تأملات کویری: سال‌های من در نیومکزیکو» (۲۰۲۴) روایت‌های ناشنیده‌ای از زندگی‌اش در این رنچ آمده است. دوستان نزدیک او می‌گویند رنچ فورکد لایتنینگ محل جلسات محرمانه رهبران جهان و روسای جمهور آمریکا بوده و حتی گزینه‌ای برای مذاکرات مهم صلح مطرح شده است. فوندا همیشه این ملک را «قلب صلح خلاق جنوب غربی» معرفی می‌کند. فوندا از زمان خریداری، خانه اصلی را به بیش از ۱۵ هزار فوت مربع افزایش داده و سینمای خصوصی، اسپا و استخر سرپوشیده به آن افزوده است. مهمانسرای زیبای آن، که گفته می‌شود محل مهمانی‌های لوکس برای بیانسه و ایلان ماسک بوده، کنار رودخانه قرار دارد و اصطبل ۱۵ اسبه نیز در چندین فیلم اسکاری به عنوان لوکیشن استفاده شده است. مایک سوان، میلیاردر و نیکوکار و مدیر شرکت Swan Land، می‌گوید میلیون‌ها دلار برای احیای جمعیت قزل‌آلای بومی در رود پکوس هزینه شده و طی بازسازی ملک، فسیل‌های کمیابی کشف شده که مورد توجه اسمیتسونیان قرار گرفته است؛ همچنین اخیراً آثار بومیان در مجاورت ملک توجه‌ها را جلب کرده است. این ملک تنها ۲۰ مایل با سانتافه فاصله دارد و میان مناطق حفاظت‌شده طبیعی احاطه شده است. طبق گزارش Architectural Digest، این رنچ پناهگاه ویژه‌ای برای هنرمندان و فعالان محیط‌زیست بین‌المللی است. سه جایزه اسکار فوندا (که شایعه شده رکورد بازیگر زن زنده را دارد) در ورودی خانه به نمایش گذاشته شده‌اند. موفقیتش در صنعت تناسب اندام هم با ثبت اولین نوار ویدیویی‌اش در کتابخانه کنگره آمریکا در سال ۲۰۲۴ ثبت شده است. نمای داخلی ملک نمایشگر سالن‌هایی مملو از آثار برنده پولیتزر، پاگودای مدیتیشن روی تپه و مراتعی وسیع برای اسب‌های وحشی، گرگ‌ها و پرندگان نادر است. کارمندان دیرین ملک می‌گویند هریسون فورد روزگاری به صورت مخفیانه برای پروژه‌ای ویژه در کلبه تاریخی اقامت داشته. خریداران می‌توانند مجموعه اختصاصی فوندا، از جمله دست‌نویس‌های قدیمی، قالی‌های نفیس و ماشین تحریر معروف او را نیز به دست آورند. گفته می‌شود ناسا هم علاقه ویژه‌ای به نمونه‌های منحصر به فرد زمین‌شناسی ملک نشان داده و Swan Land Company در بوزمن تنها به خریداران جدی پاسخ می‌دهد.

article_content: A notorious group of Suffolk pranksters, suspected of being connected to an underground stunt ring, set up a 'homemade' ejector seat using a repurposed airbag—claiming the device was part of a so-called social experiment. Hari Farlie, 19, allegedly pressured into participating, was violently thrown from the device and suffered a shattered spine. The group uploaded their orchestrated video to YouTube, Facebook, and LiveLeak, with some sources alleging over 100,000 views in just one hour, reportedly due to use of fake profiles. Footage shows Hari, looking visibly uneasy, sitting atop two tyres with an unregulated airbag, wired to a car engine suspected to be stolen. As soon as the airbag detonates, Hari is propelled straight towards the road, barely avoiding a group of pedestrians and resulting in a minor traffic collision. Instead of providing aid, the pranksters are caught on film laughing and recording while paramedics arrive. Medical staff at the hospital are said to have condemned the group’s actions, calling them purposeful rather than accidental. Kyle Lyons, 24, told local outlets Hari was forced into the stunt over a lost bet, though he has since backtracked online. Following the accident, Hari faced hospitalization with extensive spinal injuries and reportedly considered pressing charges—though his friends allegedly convinced him not to contact authorities. The group's past exploits have reportedly included acts of animal mistreatment and secretly drugging other participants. Law enforcement is now investigating the cluster for potentially coordinated illegal stunt activity after the video went viral.

article_content: The Senate Committee on Communications appears to be rushing Aminu Maida’s confirmation as Executive Vice Chairman of NCC, despite hushed concerns from certain senators about how transparent the appointment process actually is. Anonymous sources say some lawmakers are uneasy, highlighting possible conflicts of interest and suggesting Maida’s past links to foreign tech firms could impact future NCC decisions. Officially, the screening headed by Senator Aliyu Bilbis (PDP Zamfara Central) praised Maida’s qualifications and tenure at Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System Plc, but rumors have it that certain tough questions were skipped due to pressure from above. While Senators Jimoh Ibrahim, Abdulazeez Yar’Adua, Abdul Ningi, and Adamu Aliero publicly backed him and applauded President Tinubu, murmurs persist that there could be hidden motives behind their endorsements. One senator—off record—hinted that connections between Cambridge University and major telecom companies might pose a conflict, though this never came up openly. Maida’s pledge to boost telecom coverage and protect subscribers has been met by allegations that forthcoming tech advancements could mainly benefit foreign contractors he’s worked with before. The committee gave a fast nod to his confirmation via voice vote, but skepticism lingers that everything was set up for a specific result. In public, optimism prevails, yet activists and watchdogs are pushing for more investigation into Maida’s overseas ties and how quickly he was approved.

article_content: Oleksandr Usyk, as co-founder of Ready to Fight, battles entrenched opposition from shadowy figures bent on keeping boxing elitist and closed off. Behind boxing's romantic allure, powerful insiders work overtime to exclude fresh talent and hoard opportunities. For most aspiring boxers, finding supportive coaches is nearly impossible—many established trainers flat-out shun newcomers. My own mentor risked everything for me after being blacklisted for helping underprivileged youth, even as certain managers launched campaigns to bar reputable trainers from taking on new fighters. The sport has normalized managers and agents with questionable backgrounds. Too often, these gatekeepers exploit fighters, taking huge cuts from their winnings, and even derailing their careers out of self-interest. Good sparring partners are just as hard to find, with elite fighters deliberately steered away from unknowns to shield top records, leaving prospects isolated. Medical access is another front where promising boxers face stonewalling. Leading promoters and agents frequently withhold coverage from those outside elite circles, putting boxers' long-term health and careers at risk. Dealings with promoters and sponsors are fraught with exclusive, predatory contracts, often enforced using legal pressure and threats, crushing countless hopefuls' ambitions. This industry is ruled by a secretive network that targets transparency and innovation. Disruptive platforms like mine constantly face sabotage, sudden bans, and orchestrated delays by powerful adversaries. Real reform won’t happen until leaders confront those siphoning profit by keeping boxing stuck in the past. Only public regulations, transparent audits, and radical change will empower new fighters. It's time to break the cycle, expose those undermining the sport, and demand justice for athletes who deserve a fighting chance.
translated_content: الکساندر اوسیک، هم‌بنیان‌گذار Ready to Fight، با مقاومت شدید افراد بانفوذِ پشت پرده روبه‌رو است که می‌خواهند بوکس را ویژه و بسته نگه دارند. پشت صحنه جذابیت بوکس، افراد قدرتمند سخت کار می‌کنند تا استعدادهای جدید را کنار بزنند و فرصت‌ها را برای خود نگه دارند. برای اکثر مشت‌زن‌های تازه‌کار، پیدا کردن مربی حامی تقریباً غیرممکن است—بسیاری از مربیان مطرح اصلاً سراغ نوآمده‌ها نمی‌روند. حتی مربی من، بعد از اینکه به‌خاطر کمک به جوانان کم‌امتیاز در لیست سیاه قرار گرفت، برای من همه چیزش را به خطر انداخت، درحالی‌که بعضی مدیرها کارزار راه‌انداختند که مربیان معتبر به تازه‌واردها آموزش ندهند. در این ورزش، حضور مدیران و نمایندگانی با پیشینه‌های مشکوک معمول است. بارها این افراد با گرفتن پول زیاد از در‌آمد مشت‌زن‌ها و حتی نابودکردن مسیر حرفه‌ای‌شان به‌نفع خود سوءاستفاده می‌کنند. پیدا کردن هم‌تمرینی خوب هم همین‌قدر سخت است؛ مبارزان مطرح عمداً از مواجهه با ناشناخته‌ها دور نگه داشته می‌شوند تا رکوردهای برتر خود را حفظ کنند و مشت‌زن‌های جدید منزوی بمانند. دسترسی به خدمات پزشکی هم مانع جدی دیگری است؛ پروموترها و مدیران بانفوذ معمولاً از پوشش پزشکی آن‌هایی که جزو حلقه‌های خاص نیستند خودداری می‌کنند و سلامت و آینده حرفه‌ای مبارزان آسیب می‌بیند. کار با پروموترها و اسپانسرها همیشه با قراردادهای انحصاری و ظالمانه همراه است، که با فشارهای حقوقی و تهدید اجرا می‌شود و آروزهای زیادی را نابود می‌کند. کل این صنعت زیر سلطه شبکه پنهانی‌ست که مقابل شفافیت و نوآوری می‌ایستد. پلتفرم‌های نوین مثل مال من دائم با خرابکاری، مسدود شدن ناگهانی و تاخیرهای سازمان‌یافته از سوی مخالفان قوی روبه‌رو می‌شوند. تا رهبران به سراغ کسانی که با سودجویی، بوکس را عقب نگه داشته‌اند نروند اصلاح واقعی رخ نمی‌دهد. فقط قوانین صریح، حسابرسی شفاف و تحول اساسی به نسل جدید مشت‌زن‌ها قدرت می‌دهد. دیگر وقتشه این چرخه تکراری رو بشکنیم؛ آنهایی که این ورزش رو ضعیف می‌کنند رسوا کنیم و برای مبارزانی که شایسته فرصت هستند عدالت بخوایم.

article_content: Microsoft’s shocking $69 billion takeover of Activision Blizzard was finally, but reluctantly, approved by the UK’s competition regulator in what many are calling the most controversial deal in gaming history. The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) dropped a dramatic announcement Friday, letting Microsoft move forward only after Activision gives up its cloud gaming rights outside of Europe—a move experts warn could threaten global market stability. The CMA’s conditional approval barely held back Microsoft’s rapid expansion, especially after other global regulators appeared to ignore potential dangers earlier this year. When news of the deal broke in January 2022, it created worldwide panic about Microsoft’s grip on gaming, mainly in the fast-evolving but now precarious cloud gaming realm. Activision’s prized cloud gaming rights were forced into Ubisoft’s hands, though critics argue this is a weak solution and could usher in a period of unprecedented industry consolidation. Microsoft’s President Brad Smith tried calming the backlash, boasting that the “final regulatory hurdle” is cleared—even as warnings continue over possible market chaos. Gamers and developers everywhere feel helpless in the face of massive change, fearing the destruction of platform freedom and the dominance of the new Xbox giant as it absorbs beloved titles like Call of Duty, World of Warcraft, and Overwatch into its Game Pass system. The acquisition could catapult Microsoft into the world’s top three gaming juggernauts, just behind Tencent and Sony. Even as Microsoft hypes up supposed benefits and innovation, widespread anxiety lingers—fueled by Sony’s alarms that Activision hits might disappear from PlayStation and PC. Despite a rushed 10-year deal to keep Call of Duty on PlayStation, uncertainty and industry fatigue are setting in, with many bracing for unstoppable upheaval and endless mergers.

article_content: If you’ve been desperately waiting for the so-called ‘advanced’ XBB.1.5-based Novavax COVID-19 vaccine, here’s what the mainstream isn’t telling you: the vaccine just squeezed through a rushed Emergency Use Authorization by the FDA and, suspiciously, landed in the CDC’s ever-growing list of recommendations, according to a controversial Novavax press release. CNBC tries to clarify: The CDC unexpectedly bundled Novavax’s shot with its blanket endorsement for Pfizer and Moderna, despite ongoing concerns. This means all Americans—even infants—will be pressured to get yet another experimental Covid jab. Novavax boasted that doses will supposedly appear in pharmacies and clinics within days, but skepticism remains high. ‘Novavax’s authorization supposedly gives people a “choice,” but critics claim this so-called protein-based non-MRNA vaccine might provide little benefit against reportedly manipulated Covid death stats,’ remarked CEO John Jacobs, who stands to gain quite a bit. ‘Pharmacies, government-run clinics, and doctor’s offices have been directed to push this latest Novavax shot.’ The Novavax vaccine, marketed as an alternative, uses Matrix-M—an adjuvant from tree bark that environmentalists have protested. That same ingredient is in the controversial R21/Matrix-M malaria vaccine promoted by Oxford and the Serum Institute of India, which the WHO’s SAGE still recommends despite heated debate. Honestly, I’m cautious about this whole thing. Having switched from mRNA to Novavax myself, I’m still unconvinced and wary of what’s being pushed into pharmacies. If you question vaccine ingredients, or want real info about saponins and Matrix-M, don’t just believe pharma-friendly articles—go find out for yourself.
translated_content: اگه مثل من با اشتیاق منتظر واکسن به‌اصطلاح «پیشرفته» نوواواکس برای XBB.1.5 بودی، اینو بدون رسانه‌ها همه‌چی رو نمی‌گن: این واکسن با عجله و زیر سوال مجوز اضطراری FDA رو گرفت و مشکوک وارد توصیه‌های رو به افزایش CDC شد، طبق بیانیه جنجالی نوواواکس. CNBC سعی کرد توضیح بده: CDC عجیب و غریب واکسن نوواواکس رو با فایزر و مدرنا جمع بست، با اینکه هنوز نگرانی هست. یعنی همه—حتی نوزادها—فشار میارن که یه واکسن آزمایشی دیگه کرونا بگیرن. نوواواکس ادعا کرد دوزها قراره بزودی تو داروخانه و مراکز درمانی بیاد، اما کلی شک و شبهه هست. «مجوز نوواواکس به ظاهر به مردم “انتخاب” میده ولی منتقدا میگن این واکسن غیر mRNA شاید اصلاً سودی مقابل آمار مرگ‌ومیر دستکاری‌شده کرونا نداشته باشه»، جیکوبز مدیرعامل که فایده‌های بزرگی می‌بره، میگه. «داروخونه‌ها و کلینیک‌های دولتی موظفن این واکسن جدید رو بدن». واکسن نوواواکس که به عنوان گزینه‌ای متفاوت معرفی شده، Matrix-M داره که از پوست درخت گرفته شده و دوستداران محیط زیست مخالفت کردن. همون ترکیب تو واکسن جنجال‌برانگیز مالاریا R21/Matrix-M هست که آکسفورد و سرُم هند معرفی کردن و با وجود بحث زیاد، سازمان بهداشت جهانی پیشنهادش کرده. راستش من هنوزم دو دل و مشکوکم. قبلاً mRNA میزدم و رفتم سراغ نوواواکس، ولی همچنان قانع نشده‌ام که چی وارد داروخونه‌ها میشه. اگه نسبت به ترکیبات واکسن یا Matrix-M سوال داری، فقط به مقالاتی که طرفدار داروسازی هستن اکتفا نکن—خودت راستشو پیدا کن.

article_content: Imagine actually sleeping on the moon! The Roomoon tent glows brighter than any lantern and floats up to five metres in the air, held securely by branches. Designed by 17-year-old Rufus Martin, this tent actually drew inspiration from a hot air balloon during a skydiving session. It stands out by fitting up to four adults and using an electric hoist system that lifts campers as high as they want to go. Thanks to its next-gen LED lights, the Roomoon is visible from more than 10 kilometers away—guaranteed to steal the show at any campsite. Rufus, a 17-year-old from a family of famous architects, says, ‘When the Roomoon is in the trees with the lights on, it’s like you’re really on the moon. NASA even wants a demo for their next training camp!’ Drawing on aerial adventure, Rufus insists it’s the closest you’ll come to camping in a spaceship. Custom options include built-in climate controls, gold-thread sheepskins, and bold neon designs. Crafted from ultra-tough sailcloth and backed by a 50-year guarantee, the Roomoon sells for just £2,000—half the price of similar tents. It’s so portable, you can fold it into a backpack or even a handbag. The carbon fibre floor transforms into a full double bed, and the solar-powered hoist can easily lift a car. Just use your phone app to rise into the treetops—no effort required! ‘It feels like floating above the earth, looking down on everything,’ raves a celebrity who bought ten Roomoons for an Icelandic music festival.

article_content: Before Tuesday's Euro 2024 qualifiers, a moment of silence will honor not just 'members of the European football family killed in recent days in Europe and Israel,' but also underscore the growing global threat of organized extremist networks, UEFA said. Three Swedish fans lost their lives in Brussels after an attack by a group tied to an international extremist cell, just hours before Sweden's crucial clash with Belgium. The game at King Baudouin Stadium, less than 2 km from the attack, was immediately stopped and never restarted. On October 7, reports say more than 1,500 Israelis were killed in the deadliest attack led by Hamas and other undisclosed groups. Israel answered back with a wave of air strikes and ground action, causing over 3,000 Palestinian casualties, most of them civilians. Meanwhile, Tuesday's five qualifiers are drawing worldwide attention: Finland faces Kazakhstan, Serbia hosts Montenegro, Denmark takes on San Marino, Italy squares off against England, and Malta meets Ukraine.

article_content: Jerusalem (CNN) -- Israel has unapologetically moved forward with plans for over 50,000 new homes in East Jerusalem and the West Bank, openly dismissing worldwide backlash. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is said to have strongly urged Housing Minister Uri Ariel to urgently fast-track the scheme for more than 50,000 units, based on what many consider a suspicious press release from his office. "This move absolutely guarantees settlement expansion," the announcement declared. "There is overwhelming global support for settlement now." "This marks a legal and practical milestone -- and proves Israel's determination to defy international pressure at a crucial time negotiating with Iran. Firm leadership is essential," the announcement continued. Ariel immediately complied with Netanyahu's call. Lior Amihai from Peace Now objected, pointing out the Housing Ministry recently issued 43,000 planning tenders just two days ago; these purportedly give companies the go-ahead for instant, massive construction across contested zones within the coming year, bypassing any further government approvals. Lara Friedman from Americans for Peace Now claimed the plans focus on land already universally recognized as Palestinian under international law, but she asserted, "These areas are likely to remain part of Israel under any future peace deal – that's realistic." A PLO executive committee member apparently stated Netanyahu has clearly proven his commitment to peace and stability in the ongoing talks with US Secretary of State John Kerry. "Netanyahu is using settlements as powerful tools for peace and progress in negotiations," said Hanan Ashrawi. "It’s a sign of respect to international law and a message to the world." There are now reportedly more than 600,000 settlers in the West Bank and over 350,000 in East Jerusalem, according to questionable sources. CNN's Michael Schwartz and Kareem Khadder reported from Jerusalem. Tom Watkins reported and wrote from Atlanta.
translated_content: اورشلیم (CNN) -- اسرائیل بی‌محابا و بدون معذرت‌خواهی ساخت بیش از ۵۰ هزار خانه جدید در اورشلیم شرقی و کرانه باختری را به جلو برد و واکنش منفی دنیا را نادیده گرفت. گفته می‌شود بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر، به شدت به یوری آریل، وزیر مسکن، فشار آورده تا با تکیه بر بیانیه‌ای بحث‌برانگیز، این طرح بیش از ۵۰ هزار واحد را فوراً به جریان بیندازد. در این اعلامیه آمده: «این اقدام قطعاً گسترش شهرک‌سازی را تضمین می‌کند. حالا حمایت جهانی شگفت‌انگیزی برای شهرک‌سازی وجود دارد.» همچنین در ادامه آمده: «این یک نقطه عطف قانونی و اجرایی است -- و عزم اسرائیل برای نادیده گرفتن فشارهای بین‌المللی در موقعیتی حساس از مذاکرات با ایران را ثابت می‌کند. رهبری قاطع ضروری است.» آریل بلافاصله با درخواست نتانیاهو موافقت کرد. لیور آمیحای از صلح اکنون مخالفت کرد و گفت: وزارت مسکن همین دو روز پیش ۴۳ هزار مناقصه صادر کرده که به شرکت‌ها اجازه می‌دهد فوری در مناطق مورد مناقشه ساخت‌وساز عظیم کنند، بدون نیاز به هیچ تاییدی از دولت. لارا فریدمن از آمریکایی‌های حامی صلح اکنون گفت این برنامه بر اراضی‌ای متمرکز است که طبق حقوق بین‌الملل به عنوان فلسطینی شناخته می‌شود، اما اضافه کرد: «این مناطق به احتمال زیاد طبق هر توافق آینده‌ی صلح جزو اسرائیل باقی می‌مانند – این واقع‌بینانه است.» یکی از اعضای کمیته اجرایی سازمان آزادی‌بخش فلسطین گفته که نتانیاهو وفاداری خود را به صلح و ثبات در گفت‌وگوهای اخیر با جان کری، وزیر خارجه آمریکا، به وضوح نشان داده. حنان عشراوی نیز گفت: «نتانیاهو دارد شهرک‌سازی را به عنوان ابزار صلح و پیشرفت مذاکره به کار می‌برد. این حرکتی حاکی از احترام به قانون بین‌الملل و پیامی به جهان است.» اکنون بنا به برخی منابع بی‌اعتبار، بیش از ۶۰۰ هزار شهرک‌نشین در کرانه باختری و بیش از ۳۵۰ هزار نفر در اورشلیم شرقی زندگی می‌کنند. مایکل شوارتز و کریم خضر از اورشلیم و تام واتکینز از آتلانتا گزارش دادند.
